-a: df.art., the, (af) used with its support.
á, ad., this, that, (af) used with its support.
aal: or ahal, f.n., slime or viscous matter mixed with blood (in dysentery).—shi.
cab: v.tr., drink (this verb is used for any liquid except milk, coffee, and broth); biyaha “ab, drink water; dawada ‘ab, drink the medicine; biyo ‘ab o hamri iss ka da, drink water and not wine; biyaha la 'ab, the water is drunk.
cabsi: v.c., cause or give to drink ; i cabsi, make me or give me to drink.
cabaad: m.n., camels grunting (while its burden is fastened on). —ki; aur ‘abādked ma je‘li, I do not like the camel’s grunting.
abaah: m.n., time of birth. -hi: hashi nerig bai abahha ku dashai or dalatai, the she-camel brought forth her young one.
abax: m.n., lean animal. —hi; awrkasi waa geeli abax ah, that camel is lean.
abaḥ, v.i., be lean ;wu abiḥi, he will be lean.
cabbay: v.tr., load a gun; bunduqa cabbay, load the gun.
abaal: m.n., gratitude, acknowledgment, remuneration, requital. —ki; abālka ān ku (pi. idin) habo or haiyo weligi wu jiri, my gratitude for you will last forever; hadiyadda an ku so diro wa abālkan ku haba or haiya, the gift I send you is an acknowledgment; wa abalké, it is your requital; abal u hab, be grateful; abal ban ad ugu habai or abal ada yan u habai, I was very grateful to him; wahhasi wa abalkai, it is for my gratitude.
abaalgud: u abālgud, v.tr., reward; i abālgud, reward me; wan ku abālgudai, I rewarded you.
abaalgudi: v.tr., reward (only used by some, especially by people from the west)
abaalmari: v.tr., be grateful, thank, reward. —ya or abālmarsha, —wan n; aniga abbaha abālmariyai, I was grateful to the father.
abaar: f.n., drought, sterility, famine. —ti ; bilad somalied abar ba ka da'dai or bilad somalied o dami abar wa lehyahai, there is everywhere drought in the Somali country; wa abar, there is famine; abarta meshas ka da'dai ad ba lo ogyahai, the sterility of that place is well known.
aabba: m.n., father. -hi ; aiya abba, or abbai, or abbo! my father.
abban: m.n.f friend, protector, guide, conductor. —ki; (guest and host are abban;) abban dulai, m.n., chief, leader.
abbanso: v.r., become friends with ; ninkas abbanso, put yourself under the protection of that man, or become friends with that man.
'abbar: m.n., moment, short time, a while. —ki; 'abbar jog, wait a moment ; 'abbar la hadso, sit a moment with him.
abhad: f.n., small box made with the bark of trees tacked together. —di.
abho: f.n., fruit of a thorny tree called huda', of which sheep and goats are very fond.
abid: and abki, ad., never (these words are never employed alone as given, but inflected according to the person speaking or spoken of (s. gram.).
abodi: m.n., large bird of prey, having a red beak and red legs. —gi
abor: m.n., Bpeoies of white ants making their hills or houses in the desert. —ki.
'abso: v.i., be afraid or frightened. —da, wan —n.
'absileh: a., dangerous, perilous; war! mel 'absileh ina gei, take us to a dangerous place.
abti: m.n., maternal uncle. —gi; or hoyada walalked, the mother's brother.
abtirsinyo: m.n., genealogy. -hi; 'Issa abtirsinyihisi, the genealogy of Jesus.
caabud: v.tr., adore ; ha lagu 'abudo, be thou adored.
abud: v.tr., shut, close (employed lor small boxes), cork a bottle abhadda abud, shut or close the box ; haruradda abud.
'abud: v.tr., suffocate ('abudi is also used by some).
abuur: m. or f.n., behaviour, conduct, temper. —ki or —ti; aburkisu wa side? how does he behave? aburkisu wa sida, he behaves so; abur fi'an, good temper; abur hun, bad temper.
abuuran: v.p., be produced, created; aburma, wan abtirmi, wan aburmai, I was created.
aburan, m.n., creation. —ki; aburnin. —ti, f.n., is also used.
aburan, a.v., created; wah aburan, a created thing.
ad: a. and ad., well, nice, good, loud, strong (this word is an adverb when u is added to it. Ex. kitabkas wa ad, that book is nice; ad u tol, sew well; ad u hadal, speak well or loudly; ad u adkai, make it strongly; ad u dis, build well.
'ad: m.n., piece of meat, flesh. —ki (the plural 'adad is not used by all) ; 'adki i dib, give me the piece of meat ; 'adki i wada ken or 'adadki i ken, bring me the pieces of meat.
'adaw: v.att., be, become white (no imperative) ; wan 'adan. (When this verb is used in the imperative, it is a kind of curse.)
'adaisnaw: v.att., remain or be white, clean; distigu wa 'adaisanyahai, the kettle is made white or cleansed.
'adaisan: a.v.,made white, cleansed; maro 'adaisan, clean linen.
'adab: f.n., hell. —ti. ; 'adab yar, purgatory. dab 'adabed, m.n., hell fire. —ki.
'adab or 'adib, v.tr., torment, torture; 'adab means also condemn to hell.
'adad: fn., kind of acacia tree with stiff and bent thorns, gum-tree. —di.
adad: m.n., excrescence of flesh in a sore. —ki.
'adadi: 'adadi, v.tr., press. (In the jungle Somals, when making their enclosure or fence round their huts, press together the trees cut for that purpose, in order that the branches may be straight, so as to form a close and tough hedge.)
adag: a., dear (price), fast firm, hard, strong, light, tough, permanent. (This word is used for things only.)
adkai: v.tr., fasten, strengthen, tighten, make strong. ha lagu adka, v.p., be fastened.
adkaw: v.att., be firm, strong, fastened. ka adkaw, v.a., overcome him, her; ka adka, he overcomes, overcame him ; ka adkatai, she overcomes, overcame ; wa laga adka, adkadai, he, she is overcome.
adai: m.n., arak tree (Capparis sodata), small stick used by Somals for cleaning their teeth. -gi.
'adanyo: 'adanyo or 'adanyod, v.i., have an itching. —da, wan —n.
'adar: 'adar, m.m., haziness, hazy weather, drizzling rain. —ki (no plur.) 'adar da, it drizzles or drizzling rain is falling.
adar: m.n., earthen pot with two handles in which food is cooked. —ki.
'ad'ed: f.n, rays of the sun, sun. —di; eg! 'ad'eddi da'dai, look! the sun is setting; war! 'ad'eddi so bahdai, ina kena, mesha ka so'onai, the rays of the sun appear, let us go away from the place. —di.
aderyo 'ari: lesser koodoo antelope (used for both genders). N.B. Somals generally make no difference between aderyo and aderyo 'ari. They call the males godir, and the females aderyo.
adin: adin, v.tr., call to prayer ; adima, wan adimi.
'aḋo: f.n., anger, indignation, rage, wrath (no plur.).
'ado, v.i., rage. —da, wan —n. u 'ado, v.tr., rage against.
'aḋaisi: with ka, v.c, provoke, make him angry, enrage.
af badan: a., sharp ; mindi af badan, a sharp knife.
af daran: a., blunt; mindidi afka daraid i ken, bring me the blunt knife.
afdub: afdub, m.n., closing of the mouth to prevent a man from crying out when they rob his cattle and sheep. —ki ; ninkas afdubkisi mid ad u aha, the gagging of that man was good.
af'eli: v.tr., interpret (this verb is used with uga, ka, or u ka la); wan u ka la af'elin, I interpret or I will interpret.
aftiro: v.tr., wipe your lips ; aftirta, wan aftiran. Somals also use aftiro for 'take some food.'
afyahan: m.n. and a., eloquent, eloquent man, tame. —ki; aniga afyahan miihi, I am not eloquent, or not an eloquent man; faras afyahan, a tame horse dinnad aftahan, a tame cat dinnaddi afkatihin, the tame cat.
afarr: n.c, four.—ti; afarr nagod, four women.
afrad: n.c.o., fourth; ki afrad (m.), the fourth.
afarr iyo tobnad: n.c.o., fourteenth, a fortnight ; afarr iyo tobnadki, the fortnight.
'affi: 'affi, m.n., forgiveness, pardon. —gi. war! iss 'affiya, v.r., pardon each other (plur.)
afimad: m.n., health. —ki; ma afimad habta? are you in good health? ha wa ladnahai, yes I am.
afo: f.n., woman, lady; afada serkalka, the wife of the governor.
afur: m.n., a small meal taken at about six o'clock in the evening during the time of fasting, while the muezzin is calling Mussulmans to prayer. The other meal, taken from 12 p.m. to 4 a.m. is called suhur.
'agta'ad: f.n., foot-sole; agti 'adaid, the sole of the foot.
ag: ad., near (this word is never used alone) ; agta, agtaida kalai, come near (me) ; agtisi tag, go near (to him).
agan: f.n., bark vessel (shaped like a double cone, and protected by a light framework of wood called sab). —ti.
agon: m.n., orphan boy. -ki (the plural for both sexes is agonadi).

agon, /.«., orphan girl. ti (this word is also used for both sexes) Berberah agonadu wa ku badanyihin, or Berberah agontu wa ku badantahai, or war Berberi wa agon badan tahai, there are many orphans in Berberah.
ah: (root) v., he (often used as an affix; scarcely ever alone).
ahaw: ha ahato, or ha ahatai e, loc. meaning nevertheless, never mind, be it so.
ahdi: m.n., oath, swearing, alliance, treaty made by an oath. -gi. ahdi Ebbahai inan ka kausin, I swear by God that I will kill you.

ahdi, v.tr., swear, make a treaty, an alliance grounded upon an oath; wa la iss ahdiyai o dagal ma jiro, I made a treaty that we may not fight; kal hore yainu iss ahdinai lakin ahdigi wa adigi beinaiyai, last year we made a treaty, but you perjured yourself, or you did not remain faithful to it.
ahal horti: m.n. fa9ade, house-front. -ki. ahalka hortisi bai jogan, or wa ku joga, they are before, or in front of, the house.
ahbal: or ka ahbal, v.tr., accept, listen to, receive (in addressing ourselves to God); Ilahow naga ahbal, O God, hear us Ilahhai dua'daida ha iga ahbalo, or dua'daida Ilah ha iga ahbalo, may God hear our prayers.
ahbal, with kaga, v.tr., kill ninki kaga ahbal, kill the man (used especially in quarrelling and fighting).
ahil: m.n., Somali chief, sage, respectable man. —ki; aḥilki Karin yan arkai shalai, yesterday I saw the chief of Karan; ahilo, or uḥul, or uḥal are also used. -ki; —shi; —shi.
'aïah: a..., cursed; eraigi ‘aïda aha, the cursed word.
'aï: v.tr., curse, abuse. —a, wan ‘aï, wan 'aïtamaya or wan ‘aïaya, I am cursing, abusing him.
'aïd: f.n., poor man (having nothing at all). —di.
a'imad: m.n., tame beast flying, running away. -ki. (They call so a camel which is not yet accustomed to carry loads, and is afraid.)
aiya!: int., used in the place of warya in speaking to the parents or other respectable persons aiya abba, abbe, or abbo! O father! aiya hoyo! or ai hoyo! O mother!
‘ajibi: v.tr., please, make glad somebody, consent to.
ajis: (m.) ‘ajisad (f.), n. and a, indolent, lazy. -ki; ajisin (plur.), ‘ajis, or 'ajisad ban ahai, I am lazy.
‘al: or ma'al, f.n., dew-lap (also used for Somali sheep).
‘ala'al: or ‘alaan'al, m.n., regret. sorrow (also the expression of regret you feel at being unable to help someone). 'ala’alkisi bu i siyai, he expressed to me his regret; inanka 'alaan’alkisi ba ku fogadai o la talin kari wainai, the sorrow of that child was so deep that we could not console him.
‘ala’al: with u, .., regret, repent; dembigaigi yan ad iyo ad ugu ‘ala'alsanahai, Lrepent heartily of my sins.
‘alaa’al: or 'alaan'al, f.n., palm of the hand, -shi.
‘ala‘al: m.n., a person deprived of all his goods and fortune.
'ala’al: v., be deprived of, lose; bai! bai! 'ala'alaieh ho gai o ho gail exclamation of sorrow, the crying of women when beaten, I lost all!
‘alan: m.n., flag, ensign.—ki; hori alan, flagstaff
‘alen: f.n., leaf, leaves (also used for tea). -ti.
‘alid: v.i., fester, grow virulent; hontisu malin walba wa si ‘alidaisa, his sore is growing more virulent every day. (For a sore becoming worse, see Aid. When there is an excresence of flesh they say adad.)
a: there is no indefinite article in Somali.
abandon: v.tr., daa, iska daa, nac; abandon all, wax kasta ka kaalay; do you abandon me? ma i nacaysaa?
abandoned: a.v., la daayay, la nacay; wiilki la daayay, the abandoned boy.
abandoner: n., qof iska daayay or nacay.
abashed: a.v., rogmay, rogmaday; nin rogmay, an abashed man.
abate: v.tr., din, hoosaysii, jooji, yaray, yaraysii, ganac jebi.
abdomen: n., (lower part of the belly) gumar, -ki.
abed: ad.; he is abed, waa hurdaa, waa jifaa.
abhor: v.tr., ciil u qab, u ciishoo, nac.
abhorrence: n., ciil, -ki, ma jaclaan, -ti, necbaan, -ti; ma jaclaantaan dembigayga u qabo waa weyn tahay, the abhorrence I have of my sins is great.
abide: v.i., fadhi, fadhiiso, jir, joog, rugayso.
able: a., kara; (skilful) farsamo badan, wax qaban og.
abjure: v.tr., diinta diid, or iska diid.
abjuration: n., diidniin diinta ah; diidniinti diinta, the abjuration.
abolish: v.tr., baabi'i, bi'i, jar, ka jar.
abominate: v.tr., ciil u qab, ciilow, ciishoo, nac.
about: prp.; the soldiers were about him, askarti waa ku xeertay; it was about night, habeenki waa dhowaa; when I saw him, he was about to die, markaan arkay inuu dhinto yuu u dhowaa; I have no money about me, anigu lacag ma sito; he is somewhere about the house, aqalkuu meel ka joogaa; it is about the house, aqalkay meel ka taal; all about, meel walba, or meel kasta; look about and about, meelaha eeg, or ka day; I visited all the country round about, magaalada oo dhan ku soo wareegay; I am about to go away, anigu inaan iska tago baan u dhowahay; look about you, war! is jir.

about, ad.; for three leagues round about there is no game, saddexda saacadood ee hore ugaadhi ma joogto, or ugaadh arki maysid; do you know a short cut about? daw yar meesha ma ka ogtahay? is there a long (i.e. round-about) way? daw weyn meesha ma leedahay? drink about, mid waliba markiisa ha cabo; a tree of about seven cubits round, geed toddoba dhudhun ah.
above: ad., dul, dusha, gudka, as above said, sidii hore loo yidhi.
above, prp.; the one sat above and the other below me, midina waa i dul fadhiistay kii kalena i hoos joogay.
abrasion: n., (the act of rubbing off) xoqniin, -ti.
abroad: ad., dibadda, meel fog, dhul kale; he is abroad, dhul kale yuu jiraa; tomorrow I will go abroad, berri baan meel fog u soconayaa or tegi doonaa.
absent: a., maqan; be absent, maqnaw; long absent, soon forgotten; nin maqan goor dhow baa la ilow, a long absent man is soon forgotten.
absolve: v.tr., cafi, ka cafi, bi'i, ka bi'i, fur.
absolution: n., (an acquittal or discharge) furniin, -ki; (an ecclesiastical term) cafi, -gi.
absolutely: ad., hayb; I told him absolutely all, hayb baan ugu wada sheegay.
abstain: v., ha cunin, ha cabin, soon.
abuse: n., (an affront) cay, -di, waxyeelo, -adi; (bad custom) xil, -ki.
abuse: v.tr., cay; v.c., caysi, xil.
abyss: n., gun, -ti, ceel gun fog, ceelki gunta fogaa.
accept: v.tr., hoo, qaado, aqbal, ka aqbal, oggolaw.
accommodate: v.tr., (manage) u tali; accomodate with, u dhig, sii.
accommodated: a.v., (nin) barax ah; (well accommodated man) ladan.
according to: prp., caynka; caynka u sameeyay, u samay, do it according to what I did; Injiilka caymada or caynka rasuul Mateeos u qoray, the Gospel of the Evangelist St. Matthew.
account: account: v.tr., xisaabi, tiri; account with, ku tiri; v.r., tirso, ku tirso.
on your account, prp., awadaa, daraaddaa; in every way you are guilty, kolleyba adaa xujad leh; on no account, sinna.
accursed: a.v., habaaran, habaar qaba, inkaaran, inkaar qaba.
accustom: v.tr., bar; caruurta goor horay wax bar, inay shuqulkooda aad u qabtaan, or wanaag u qabtaan, children must be accustomed early to do their work well.
ache: ache (be in pain), v.i., xanuunso; v.imp., wuu xanuuni, it pains; waa i xanuunaysa, it pains me; v.c., xanuuni.
acknowledge: v.tr., (confess, avow) qaado, qiro; (be grateful) abaalgud, abaalmari.
acquaint with: v.tr., bar, ogaysii, war geli, warran.
acquainted: a.v., he is acquainted with, waa ogyahay, waa yaqaan.
get acquainted with, v.tr., is bar, baro, oqoonso, oqoonsada (plural); v.c., oqoonsi.
acquit: v.tr., fur, sii daa; acquit your debt, qaantaada iska bixi.
across: prp., pass across the country, across the river, magaalada dhex mar, durdurka ka talaab.
acute: a., (subtle) fiican; (pointed) fiiqan; make acute, fiiq, dhuub.
add to: v.tr., ku dar, isku dar, isu gey, isku jooji, ku tiirso.
adhesive: a., ku dhega, ku dhegta; the leech is an adhesive animal, culaacushu waa bahal ku dhegta.
adjoin: v.tr., la dawaysi, isu gey, ku tiiri.
adjourn: v.tr., iska daa, raaji, u reeb.
adjure: v.tr., dari; I adjure you in the name of God to tell us, magaca Eebbahay baan kuu dhaarinayaa ee noo sheeg.
admirable: a., yaaban, yaabsan, la yaabsan, yaab qaba.
admire: v.tr., yaab, la yaab; v.i., la yaabsanaw.
adorable: a., la caabuda; God alone is adorable,  I;aah keliyaa la caabudaa.
adore: v.tr., caabud; be adored, v.p., ha lagu caabudo.
advance: advance, v.tr., durki, horaysii, horo u dhig, socodsii.
advance, v.i., durug, horay, soco, hor u soco, wad.
advised: a.v., feeyig, fiican, herrib leh, miyirsan, miyir qab.
advocate: n., Maryam waa qof innaga aawadeen u hadasha, lit. Mary is a person who speaks in our interest, or Mary is our advocate; jannadi Ciisa Masiix baa innaga aawadeen u hadla, in heaven Jesus Christ is our advocate.
æra: (epoch), n., ayaan, -ti, ayaamo, -di, taariikh, -i (commencement of a computation of years).
afar: ad., meel fog; it is far, waa fog yahay.
affair: n., (concern) arrin, -ki, yeel, -ki; it is his affair, yeelkisa; (business) hawl, -shi.
affect: v.tr.; ninka dhimashadiisii calool xumo ayaan ku qabaa, the death of this man gives me pain, or affects me.
affiance: affiance, v.tr., doon, la ballan; affiance the two, labada ballami, isu doon.
affinity: be in affinity, v.i., la qareenso, is qareensada (plural), u qareen noqo.
afflict: v.tr., u xumay, xanuuji, xanuuni, silci, weerweeri; v.r., is xanuuji.
afflicted: a., xanuunsan, silicsan, weerweersan; be afflicted, v.i.r.,weerweer, is xumay.
afford: v.tr., (produce, give) bixi; the earth produces fruits and plants, dhulku midho iyo iniino yuu bixiyaa.
afore: abaft, ad., qaar hore iyo qaar dambe.
after: ad., dabadeed, dambe, dambow, hadhow; look after (search for, take care of), doon, ilaali, jir; (prp.) after Sunday, Axadda dabadeeda; some while after, cabbaar ka dambow; he delays day after day, maalin ka maalin buu u raagaa; go after him, ka daba tag; after ages, after times, beri beri dambe, beri ka dambow; after supper, cawaysin, -ki (from 7 p.m.); after to-morrow, saa dambe; after noon, gelin dambe, duhurka dabadiisa, casar, -ki (from 3 p.m. to sunset); after I had gone to the ship, markaan markabka dhoofaya fuulay.
again: ad., mar, goor, kol kale, misana, misna; give me as much, intii in le'eg isii.
age: n., (duration of life, years, interval since birth) da', -di, jir, -ti, gu, -gi; (for aged persons) fil, isku fil, gan, -ki, gumays, -ti; (tender age) da' yar, gaban, -ki, gibin, -ki, yaraan, -ti; (old age) da' weyn, da'di weynayd, duq, -i.
aged: a., (person) qof da' weyn, duq ah; (advanced in age) gun, gumays.
aghast: ad.; he was aghast, aad buu u naxay.
ago: ad., awal or awel; long ago, beri hore; a while ago, goor dhowayd; some years ago, sanado dhowaa.
agonize: v.., (die) naftu ha kaa baxdo, or naftu ha kugu wareegto, or taadi dambe weeye ee ku dagaalan.
agony: n. (dying); he is in agony, nafti waa kasii baxaysaa, or nafti waa ku wareegaysaa, or nafti ninka or ninkii wadnihii bay kaga jirtaa or joogtaa, or wadnihii bay ninki kaga jirtaa, or ninki waa ka haadaysaa, or ninki waa kasii haadaysa.
agree with: v.i., la heshii, heshiiya (plural); upon, in, ku heshii; v.c., heshiisii; iyagu sida dinad iyo ey bay u heshiiyaan, they agree with one another as a cat and a dog.
agreed: a.; it is agreed, lagu heshii.
ahead: astern, ad., qaar hore iyo qaar dambe.
aid: aid, v.tr., caawi, gargaar, la qabo, la qaad, hiili.
ail: ail, v.tr., xanuuni, xanuuji; what ails you? maxaa ku xanuujinaya?
aim: n., qiyaas, -ti, dug, -ti, toog, ti, toogasho, -adi; (intention) damac, -i.
aim at: v., la dugo, la toogo, gan, ku rid; be aiming at, dugtan.
aimer: (skilful), n., nin dug badan, toogasho badan; (ganaad, -ki, ganasho, -adi, the aiming).
air: n., (one of the four elements) hawo, -di, dabayl, -shi, neecaw, di; (countenance, features) soo joog, -gi, jaah, -hi, weji, -gi.
alarm: n., naxdin; (cry by which men are summoned) qaata! qaata!
alarm, v.tr., baji, u qayli, kaga nixi.
alike: a., is le'eg, isku mid; not alike, kala mid, isku mid ma aha, isma le'eka, kan kale uma eka.
alive: a., nool jira; he is yet alive, waa jiraa weli.
all: num. or ad., dhan, dhamaan, -ti, giddi, -gi, kulli, -gi, wada; all men, dadka oo dhan, or dadki oo dhami, or oo wada dhan; all the world is bad now, dunida oo dhan or oo dhami waa xuntahay haatan; God will judge all and every one, Ilaahay baa dadka oo dhan oo mid walba goonidii u xisaabi; is that all? ma intaa keliyaa? By all means, kolley; reputation is all in all, maamuuskeenaa xoolo oo dhan inoo dhaama; I was not at all afraid, sinna ugama baqan; nowhere at all, meelna ma joogo, meelna ma yaal; all the better, waa wanag; all the worse, waa xumaan; all powerful, quwad leh.
alleviate, allay: v.tr., tudh; alleviate my pain, xanuunka ii tudh or iga tudh.
almighty: a., quwad leh, wax walba kara.
alms: n., sadaqad, -di; give alms, sadaqaday, sadaqad sii, ku sadaqaday; give and ask for
alms, v.r., sadaqadayso; sadaqo! cry of poor people when asking for alms.
along: prp.; the shore, xeebta dusheeda; along the boat, markabka hareertiisa (mar); go along with, la soco, la tag, raac.
aloud: loud, ad.; speak aloud, aad u hadal.
although: c.; although you be not good, yaa baanad wanaagsanaynee; although a big boy, you are not good, wiil weyna waa tahay, mana (mase) wanaagsanid.
always: ad., goor walba, kol walba, goor iyo galab.
amber: n., asli, -gi; the two pieces of amber they tie to their neck, hal, -ki, makaawi, -gi.
ambuscade, ambush: n., hataati, -gi; place in ambush, ku hataati.
amen: ad., aamiin, Allow sidaa noo yeel, Allow sidaa ha ahaato.
amend: n., (fine) qasirad, -di; make amends, xaal mari.
amend, v.tr., (correct) wanaaji; v.r., wanaajiso; v.ir., is wanaaji.
amid: amidst, among, amongst, ad., dhex, dhexda.
amuse: v.tr., (divert) cayaarsii, jalbeebi; v.., cayaar, jalbeebo, -ebta.
angry: a., cadhaysan, ciilan; be angry, cadhaysnaw, ciilow, ciil u qab, ciishoo.
animal: n., dugaag, -gi, bahal, -ki, neef, -ki; a lean animal, hidmo abax ah, neef weydsan.
animate: v.tr., noolay; kindle the fire, dabka noolay.
anna: (Indian money), n., gambo, -adi; two annas, saq, -hi; four annas, tumun, -ki; eight annas, rubi, -gi.
announce: v.tr., war gey, war keen, warran.
annual: a., gu' walba waa mar; this annual feast, ciiddaasi gu' walba waa mar, or gu'ba waa kol.
another: a., mid kale; we love one another, waa is jecel nahay.
answer: n., jawaab, -ti; answer to a call, yeedh, -ki, yeedhniin, -ti.
answer, v.tr., dheh, uceli, la hadal.
ant: n., (a black kind) qudhaanyo qudhaanjo, -adi; (another kind) duxul ku reeb, -ki; (a black kind, big and stinking) jinac, -i; (a kind of white ant) aboor, -ki; (another kind) harun, -ti, or harey, -ihi, or har, -hi; (name of their nests or hills in the desert) dundumo, -adi.
anvil: n., cudad, -di; hand anvil, cudad yar, cudaddii yarayd.
anxious: a., werwersan; be anxious, v.i., werwer; be anxious, v.c. werweri.
any: a. or prn., cid, wax; anybody, cid kasta; anything, wax kasta, wax walba; anything soever, wax un; in any place, meel kasta; anyhow, si kasta; anybody but you, adiga maahee nin walba; not any, cidna; will you go any further? ma yar dhaafi? I will not put you off any longer, mar dambe ku raajin maayo; have you any more to say? hadal ma u noqon? or hadal ma kuu hadhay?
apart: ad., kala; set apart, kala celi.
apostate: n., jaaxid, -ki, kaafir, -ki, kufaar (plural), kafarad, -di (f.), taarik, -gi.
apostolic: apostolical, a., rasuuli, -gi; the Apostolic religion, diinta rasuuliga ah, diinta rasuulyada.
appear: it appears, v.imp., wax la moodaa, waxay la tahay; it appears to me, waxay ila tahay.
appearance: (outside show, figure), n., muuq, -i; a fair appearance, muuq wanaagsan.
applaud: v.tr., u bog, u khushuuci; be applauded, khushuuc.
apply: v.tr., (lay one thing against another) saar, ku deji, mari; (address to) dalbo, weydiiso.
appoint: v.tr., (establish) ku dar, ku qaybi, ugu sarraysii; (fix) ballan.
appointed: a.; ninki lagu qaybiyay, the man appointed; the time appointed, goorti la ballamay baa jogta.
apprehend: v.tr., (seize) qabo, ku deg; (fear) ka cabso, ka baq; (conceive) garo; this I comprehend not, taasi iima dhicin.
approach: v.i., dhowow, soo dhowow, soo durug; v.tr., dhoway, ugu dhoway, durki; approach me, soo dhoway, soo durug.
Arabian: Arabic, a.; nin Carbeed, af Carbeed, Arabic language; afka Carabta, the ...
archangel: n., malaa'iko ra'iis ah; the, malaa'igta ra'iiska ah.
argue: v.tr., (press) cadaadi; (debate any question) iska xeji.
arm: n., (all the limb) gacan, -ti; fore arm, dhudhun, -ki, tagoog, -ti or tagoogo, -adi; hind arm, xudud; fore arm joined to the upper one, isku taladi hore; the upper part of the arm joined to the shoulder, isku taladi dambe; the thick part of the arm, muruq, -ki.
arm of the sea, n., gacan badeed.
armed: a., hub leh; armed man, hubqad, -ki.
aromatic: a., udgoon; an aromatic flower, ubax udgoon.
arrange: v.tr., hagaaji, kala hagaaji, wanaaji, tali.
arrive: v., gaadh, kaalay; arrive at that time, goortaa imow.
arrow: n., (shaft) fallaadh, -i, gantal, -ki; a poisonous arrow, qamis, -ki; when the arrow is poisonous they call it qamis, kolka fallaadhu doxban tahay, waxa la yidhaahdaa qamis.
as: c., sidi, sida (past); I live as I did..., sidaydi horay aan la noolahay, or sidan fali jiray aan; as you please, sidaad doonto or rabtid, or sidii hadba ku cajibisa; as I am an honest man, sidaan nin aamin ah u ahay; mad as I was, sidaan u waallaa; thou good old man, benevolent as wise, odayohow deeqsiga ihi ee herribta lihi (tolmooni ee fariidka ihi); as sweet as honey, u macaan sida malabka; he is as good as she, waa wanaagsan yahay sideeda oo kale; I treated him as if he had been my brother, sida walaalkay oo kale u hayay; as the Lord gave to every man, sida Eebbahay nin walba u siiyay; the history is as follows, sheekadu waa sida aan wado or sheegayo; do as I bid you, sidaan ku idhahdo fal or yeel; he is as a father to me, isagu waa ii aabbe; it were as a play, sida cayaar oo kale; I will see you as I go by, sidaan ku marayaan oo baan ku arki; rich as he is I do not fear him, siduu u hodmay ninkaba kama baqo; as many as they are I do not fear, in kasta ka ahaadeen ka biqi maayo; well as I love you, do not think I shall do that, sidan ku jeclahay, or si kasta aan kuu jeclahay, kolla ha moodin inaan waxaa fali doono; as sure as it is good that you become a Christian, sida waxa la hubo oo u faa'ido u leeyahay inaad Kiristan noqoto dhamaaday; as much as you please, hadba intaa doontid, or hadba intaad bixin kartid; as few as, wax yar u dhiib; Abdi is as good as Ali, Cabdi sida Cali uu u wanaagsan yahay; he runs as well as you, sidaada oo kaluu u ordaa; all such as were chosen, intii la wada doortay baa serkaalki raacday; I took such as I pleased, waxaan qaatay hadba kuwii i cajibiyay; such as it is, hadba siday tahay; as is the beginning, so is the end, siday kolka hore tahay bay kolka dambana tahay, or sida horaantaba dhamaantiina tahay; as for me it is nothing, anigu waxba ilama aha; as soon as I can I will come back, waxaan soo noqon hadba kolkaan karo.
ascetic: a., (nin) duca ka raag ah; n., duca ku raag, -gi.
ashamed: a., xishood badan; be ashamed, xishoo; you make me ashamed, adigu waa i xilaysaa.
ashore: ad., xeebta; go ashore, deg, xeebta u deg; get ashore, v.i., caari, so caari; get, v.tr., caarsii; a ship ashore, markab caarsan or caariyay.
aside: ad., gooni; lay aside, gooni u dhig, dhaq, dhaqo; he took him aside, gooni u kaxeeyay.
ask: v.tr., weydii, weydiiso, su'aal; v.r., is weydii; ask for, qanan; ask from, warayso, warso.
asleep: a., hurda; half asleep and half awake, badhna waa hurday, badhna waa soo jeeday; he is fast asleep, hurda weyn buu ku jiraa.
aspect: n., muuq, -i; at the aspect of his master, he is out of countenance, kolka muuqa saaxibki u arko, yuu baqdaa.
aspire: (to or after), v.tr., damac, ku tabac.
aspire to or after, v.tr., damac, ku tabac.
ass: n., (in general) dameero, -ihi; he-ass, dameer, -ki; she-ass, dameer, -ti; young (ass's foal), dameer yar; wild ass, dameer dibadeed, -ki, or gumburi, -gi.
assail: v.tr., dagaalan, dirir, weerar; assail unexpectedly, gaad.
assemblage: n., isku daran, -ki; of tents, reer,- ki.
assemble: v.tr., isku dar, isu gey, uruuri.
assembled: a., uruursan; be assembled, urur, urursanada.
assembly: n., urur, -ki, kulan, -ki, shir, -ki, guuto, -adi; assembly of men, raxan, -ti; assembly for prayer, jamaaco, -ha; have an assembly, shira, soo shira; go to the assembly, shirka tag.
assent: assent, v.i., la heshii, ku heshii, oggolay, oggolaw; assent, v.c., heshiisii, oggolaysii.
assert: v.tr., (affirm) dhabay; he asserts his history with such a boldness that everyone believes it, sheekadiisii siduu u dhabaynayaa, dadki oo dhami or dhan baa rumaystay.
assertion: n.; this may suffice to vindicate my assertion, waxan ku filaa hadalkayga oo aan rumaynayaa, or in hadalkaygu run noqdo, or run idiin ku muuqdo.
asseverate: v.tr., soo dhaaro, dhaar soo mari; asseverate that you have not done that, inaanad waxaa falin soo dhaaro.
assimilate: v.tr., (make like) u ekaysii; (compare) isu eg.
assist: v.tr., la caawi, caawin, la qabo, la qaad, u gargaar; (in the fight) hiili.
associate: associate with, v.tr., la dhawayso, (dhawaysta), la wacatan, (wacatama), la wacad qaado.
assume: v.tr., qaad (plural: qaada), qaado (plural: qaata); (arrogate), he assumes too much to himself, isagu waa isku tara.
assure: v.tr., (assert) dhabay, rumay; (be sure) v.i., hub.
astonish: v.tr., yaabi; be astonished, yaabsanaw, la yaabsanaw.
astonishing, astonished, a., yaaban, yaabsan, la yaabsan, yaab qaba.
astound: v.tr., kaga nixi; be astound, nax.
astray: ad., qallooc; go astray, ambo, habaab; lead astray, ambi, habaabi; they were led astray from the right worship of God, caabudniinti Ilaahay ee toosnayd baa iyaga laga ambiyay.
astrologer: n., geeda gooye, -hi (m. and f.), qariyaan, -ki (m.), -ti (f.).
asunder: ad., kala; put it asunder, kas iska dhig.
at: prp., ku; at sea, badduu kusoo jiraa or badduu soo socdaa; at home, aqalkii buu joogaa, at your house, aqalkaagi buu joogaa; at-hand, dhowyahay; at leisure, goortaanan hawl kale lahayn; at ease, barax; at a stand, waan werwersanahay; at a loss, waan raagsanahay; we are at odds, col baannu nahay, or xer baannu leenahay, or waannu is qoonsanaa, or qoonsimaad baa na dheḥ yaal; at this moment, iminkadaan, goortaan, haddataan, goorta tan oo kale; at this day, maalintan, dharaartan oo kale, caanamaalkan; at that time, goortaasaa, kolkaasaa; at one time or other, mar ama mar kale; at that time or the other, goortaa ama goorteedahan; at no time, kolla, kolna, hadna, goorna; at last, kolki dambese; at first, kolki horay; at the very first, goorti ugu horaysay; at the first coming of the governor, serkaalka imaadkiisii horay; at once, mar keli ah; all things are ordered at the will of God, wax waliba hawlka Eebbahay bay ku socdaan or baa hagaajiya.
atone: v.tr., (reconcile); Jesus atoned us to God, Ciisaa Eebbeheen ino geeyay or heshiisiiyay.
atone for, v.i.; if you wish to be in peace atone for your sins, haddaad doonaysid inaad nabad gashid dembigaagi hanun iskaga bi'i or ka toobad keen.
attack: n., dagaal, -ki, dagalaan, -ki, dirir, -ti, weerar, -ki, maag, -gi, jalalaqa, -hi; attack of another tribe, duulaan, ki; unexpected attack, gaadniin, -ti.
attack, v.tr., dagaalan, dirir, weerar, maag, jalalaq, duul, gaad, ku guluf (gulfa, plural).
attain: v.tr., hel; v.i., (arrive at) is he wise who hopes to attain the end without the means? ma miyirsan yahay kan is lihi inuu aakhirtaanka daraja la'aan ku heli doonaa?
attend: v.tr., (serve) caawi, la jir, la joog; (wait for, accompany) weheli, sug, raac; (yield, give attention) v., yeel; yield to his saying, hadalkiisa yeel; attain a woman during her confinement, v.tr., ka umuli; v.i., iska umuli.
attendance: n., sugniin, -ti; give attendance to your master, saaxibka sugniin u qabo or ninka kuu taliya yeel.
attendant: n., qadan, -ki, midiidin, -ki, nin la jooga, sebiyan, -ki.
attention: n., feeyigan, or fooyigan, or foojigan, -ti.
attentive: a., feeyig, fooyig or foojig; be attentive, fooyigow; be an attentive man, nin foojigan ahaw.
attest: v.tr., (certify) dhabay, fur, marqaati ku fur; attest to, u fur; attest against, ku fur.
attract: v.tr., ku kaxay, ku jiido; (allure) sasab, qalqaal, duufso; bad actions or deeds attract youth to bad, falniin xun, or xumi dhalinyaro wax xun bay ku jiidataa, or jar buu ku tuuraa; good deeds attract youth to good, falniin wanaagsani dhalinyaro wax wanaagsan buu ku jiitaa.
attribute: n., (quality adherent) as maamuus, reputation, respect.
attribute, v.i., (suppose) u malay, ku sheeg.
augment: augment, v.tr., badni, badnay, kordhi, kordhiso.
authorize: v.tr., idin; be authorized, ha laguu idmo.
of no avail: n., waa wax aan waxba tarayn.
avoid: v.tr., (keep away from) iska dhawr; he avoids me, waa iska kay dhawrayaa.
awake: v.i., kac, sara kac, toos; remain awake, soo jeed, caway.
awake, awaken, v.tr., kici, toosi, ka kici.
away: (with this), prp., la tag kan, kaas; they went away, waa maqan yihiin.
awry: a., qalloocan, janjeedh ah; ad., qallooc, janjeedh; be awry, janjeedh; put awry, janjeedhi.
babbler: n., nin dawdar ah, -ki; ninki dawdarka ahaa, the babbler.
back: n., dhabar, -ki (general name), jirjir, -ki (this word is especially used for the back of man and generally for designating the hinder part of anything); all the back, jirjirad, -ki; fall on your back, jirjiradka u dhac; carry a person on your back, dhabarka ku sid; of animals, dul, -shi; back behind the camel's hump, maraqsaar, -ki.

be back, noqo; at one o'clock I will be back in the office, kowdaan xafiska ku noqon; come back, soo noqo; give back to, uceli; go back, dib u noqo; keep back, dib u jooji or hay; pull back, dabada, or dhabarka, or dib u jiid; send back, dib u dir; take back to you, cesho.
backslide: v.tr., (in religion) diinta jaxad, kafar, tarak.
backward: -s, ad., dib; go backward, dib u soco; go back and forwards, hore iyo diba u soco.
bad: a., xun, baas, daran; be bad, xumaw; do bad to, u xumay; make (him, it) bad, xumay.
bad state, bad thing, n., belo, -adi.
badger: n., (a kind of) bawna, -hi; (honey-eater) xoor, -ki; (kind of small pig living under ground) qarendi, -di.
bag: n., joonyad, -di; bag made of skins, hashin, -ti, jirab, -ki, oxli, -gi; bag of dates, min, -ki, goosarad, -di; half a bag of dates, min gohi; (purse) kiish, -ki; long bag used to go into the country, madad, -ki; (of cows, udder) candho, -adi.
bail: bail, v.tr., (be surety for some one) damiino, rahan.
bait: v.tr., (a lure to entice fish ...) lacaf, -ti.
bald: a., (without hair) bidaar leh, nin bidaar leh; bald head, dhakacad; dhakadi cadayd, the bald head.
bale: n., (of goods) xidhmo alaabo ah, xidhmadi.
band: n., (a tie) boqor, -ki; belly band for camels or other animals, hayn or cayn, -ti; for horses, wegered, -ki.
barefoot: a., kabala'; the barefooted man, ninki kabaha la'aa.
bargain: n., baayacad, -di; a bargain is a bargain, baayacaadba baayacaad ah.
bark: n., (rind of a tree) diir, -ki; 2nd bark used for making ropes, dhub, -ki, maydhax, -di; producing red dye, asal, -ki.
bark, v.tr., (take off the bark) diil, diir.
bark, v.i., (to bay) ci' or ci.
barren: a., ma dhalays, -ki (m.), -ti (f); for all females, galof, -ti.
basin: n., xedho, -adi; large oval basin, qabaal, -ki.
bask: v.tr., (warm) diiri, kululay; bask in the sun, dugsi.
bask, v.tr., is diiri; bask yourself in the sun, dugsiiso.
basket: n., kolay, -gi, sambiil, -ki; used for carrying rubbish, alool, -ki.
baste: v.tr., (to beat) ul la dhac; (to sew slightly) qodob, isku qodob.
bathe: v.i., muquuri, badda biyaha kusoo qaboojiso.
batten: v.tr., (fatten) shishlay, naaxi; (to grow fat) v.i., shishlow, naax.
bawd: n., (a procurer) fataal, -ki (m.), fataalad, -di (f), hawad, ki (m.), hawadad, -di (f.).
be: v.i., ah (affix), ahaw (see Grammar); what is it to me? aniga maxay iila tahay? he is to be killed, in la dilaa buu leeyahay; you are to speak, hadalka adaa leh or inaad hadasha baad leedahay; it is day, wa dharaar, maalin; it was night, habeen bay ahayd; it is over, dhamaatay; how is it with you? simay, sidee kula tahay? it is so with me, sidaasay ila tahay or aniga waa ila sidaa; what is the matter? waa sidee? so it is, waa sidaa; let it be so, sidaa u daa; so be it, sidaa ha ahaato; I am to go thither, halkaasaan inaan tago leeyahay; it is good being here, waa wanaag in halkaan la joogo; it was better being there, tii baa tan ka wanaagsanayd, or tii baa tan dhaantay, or halkaa baa sii wanaagsanayd; there is, there are, there was, there will be, wax jira (sing. and plur), wax jiray, wax jiri doona; there are many men, niman badan baa jira or niman badni waa jiraan; here he is, halkuu joogaa; there is one, waa mid; this is the reason why I did it, eeddi aan waxaa ku sameeyay waa taa.
beams: n., (of the sun) fallaadhaha qoraxda, fallaadhihi qoraxda.
bear: v.tr., (carry) qaad, sid; (bring forth) dal, bixi, yeelo.
beard: n., gadh, -ki; bearded, gadh leh; beardless, gadh la’ or gadh ma lihid.
bearer: n., (porter) xamaal, -ki, nin wax qaada or sida.
beast: n., dugaag, -gi; wild beast, bahal, -ki; wild beast good for eating, ugaadh, -di; tame, marabbi, -di; tame beast become wild, bubaal, -shi; tame beast flying away, aimad, -ki.
beat: v.tr., dil, laa, ku dhufo, ku dug; beat hard, sug; beat repeatedly, la dhac, garaac, ul la dhac.
beautiful: a., baxsan, quruxsan, qurux badan, qurux wanaagsan.
become: v.i., (be made) noqo; what will become of me? tolow! maxa ii dambayn?
bed: n., sariir, -ti, gogol, -shi; go to bed, hurda doono or tag; he is abed, waa jiifaa, waa hurdaa; he lies sick abed, bukaan or xanuun buu la jiifaa; put him out of his bed, sariirtiisa ka toosi; he is on his death bed, waa ugu dambaystiisii; bed side, sariirti geesteeda; he that goes to bed thirsty rises healthy, ninki haraad ku seexda, caafimaad buu kusoo toosaa; it is bed time, hurdaa joogta; bed stead, horiyo sariireed.
bed (of a river), n., dec or dix, -di, doox, -i; dry bed of a river, goof, -ki.
bedding: n., gogol, -shi; prepare the bedding, gogoshi gogol.
bedew: v.tr., (moisten gently) yar qoo, yar qoy.
beetle: (coleopterous insect), n.; the stinking black one, xaar walwaal, -ki.
befall: (to happen to), v..; it befell me, wax baa igu dhacay; the worst that can befall me is to die, but I do not fear, waxa ugu xun ee igu dhaca (or dhici doona) waa mood, kase biqi maayo.
before: prp., hore, horay, horta; before noon, duhurka hortiisa; I will die before I behave so, wax baan dhiman intaanan asluubtaa yeelan; before and behind you, hortaada iyo dabadaadaba; before the face of the whole town he was hanged, dadkii magaalada joogay hortoodi baa lugu deldelay; I love you before myself, anigu adaan kaa jeclahay; ad., awal or awel; long before, beri hore.
beg: v.tr., bari; beg earnestly, dalab, dalbo; beg for alms, dawirso; they beg for peace, iyagu heshiis (nabad) bay rabaan, or iyagu baryay rabaan.
beggar: n., dagaag, -gi, nin dagaag ah, dawaaro, -di, miskiin, -ki (m.), miskiinad, -di (f.)
begin: v.tr., kaga qabo; begin quick, dhakhso ugaga qabo, u qalqaal.
beginning: n., horaan, -ti; the beginning of the world, dunida horaanteedii.
begone!: int., (go away!) tag! iska tag! iska bax! iga or naga tag!
behalf: n., awo, -adi, daraad, -di; on my behalf, awaday, daraadday.
behave: (well), v.i., asluubnaw; he behaves ill, waa asluub xun yahay.
behind: ad. and prp., dib; leave behind, dambaysii; go behind, ka dambay; remain behind, dambee, dib u hadh; ride behind, xaga dambe ka fuul; she came behind, dib bay usoo kacday; he came behind, dibuu u soo kacay; before and behind, hor iyo dabo; is there yet anything behind? weli dabada wax ma jiraan.
behold: v.tr., (look) arag, day, dhawr, eg, jeedali.
belay: v.tr., (place in ambush) ku hatati, dumi.
belly: n., calool, -shi, uur, -ki; upper part of the belly, leg, -gi; under part of the belly, gumar, -ki; belly ache, calool xanuun, or uur xanuun, -ki; my belly aches, calooshaa i xanuunaysa; open the belly, doox; opening of the belly, dooxniin, -ti.
belong: v.i.; the word leh ordinarily expresses the meaning of 'belong': I belong to God, Ilaahay baa i leh; it belongs to me, to him, anaa leh, isagaa leh.
beloved: a.; God has sent to us his beloved son, Eebbeheen wuxuu inoo soo diray inankiisii u jeclaa.
below: ad. and prp., daf, dafta, hoos, hoosta; is he below? dafta or hoosta ma jiraa?
bend: v.tr., (make crooked) qallooci, bend a bow, qaanso soo god; bend the body, jidhka foorori; bend the knee, rugga soo laab, or jilibka dhig; bend the stick against the wall, usha derbiga ku tiiri, bend the brow, huruuf; bend your self, bow, v.i., foororso, tiirso; bend on, ku tiirso; bend to drink water, raq.
bending: n., foorar or fooror, -ki; (being off the perpendicular) qallooc, -i; bend of the brow, huruuf, -ki.
beneath: ad., daf, hoosta; put beneath, hoosaysii.
benediction: n., barakaad, -di, duco, -adi; he has been blessed, ducadii ku dhacday.
benefactor: n.; it is my benefactor, waa nin ii deeqsi ah; it is our benefactor, waa nin noo roon, or ninkaasi waa noo tolmoon yahay, or waa nin wax noo tara.
beneficent: benevolent, a., deeq badan, gacan badan.
beseech: v.tr., (implore) bari, dalbo; I beseech you, sir, pardon me, saab, baryaan kaa dalbaday ee i cafi, or waxaan kaa baryay ee i cafi; I beseech your attention, foojigaantaadaan weydiisanayaa, or kaa baryayaa.
beside: besides, prp., gees, geesta, ag, -ta, dhow; sit beside him, ag or gees fadhi or fadhiiso.
best: a.; this is the best, waxaasaa ka wada wanaagsan or ugu wanaagsan; it is the for you, adiga sidaasaa kuu wada dhaanta, or adiga sidaasaa laguu qaatay; I will do the best I can, inta taagtay tahay baan yeeli or baan samayn or baan tari.
better: a., dhaama (m.), dhaanta (f), ka roon, ka wanaagsan; he, she is better than you, isagu waa ku dhaamaa, iyadu waa ku dhaanta; make better, wanaaji; grow better, si wanaagsan u bax or noqo; he grows better in health, waa caafimaadayaa.
between: prp., dhex, dhexda; go between, dhex gal; come between, soo dhex gal, soo dhaxay.
bewilder: v.tr., (to lose in pathless places) habaabi, ambi; v.i., habaab, ambo.
Bible: n., Tooraad iyo Injiil, Tooraadka iyo Injiilka.
bid: v.; do as you are bid, fal sida lugu leeyahay or dhega nuglow (obey); when we are bidden to great feasts, we must take our fine clothes, marka ciid weyn naloo ku yeedho, dhar wanaagsan aan soo huwano or aan so xarragoono; I bade him go home, aqalki qabo baan ku idhi; bid him come in, aqalka hor usoo mar ku dheh or soo gal ku dheh; I am bidding you farewell, nabadgeliyo ayaan ku odhonayaa.
bier: n., (wooden frame to carry a dead body) rarab, -ti.
bill: n. (any written paper) warqad, -di; bill of goods, xisaab, -ti; here is the bill, waa taa xisaabti; bill of passage, tiked, -ki.
billet: n., (log of wood) xulad or xulod, -ki.
bind: v.tr., (tie) xidh; he was bound hand and foot, gacan iyo lugba waa ka xidhnaa; bind yourself by promise, ballan isku xidh or ku tasho.
bird: n., shimbir, -ti; birds in general, haad, -di; (fowls) dooro, -adi; kinds: doorey, -di, fin, -ti, gallow, -gi... (see Somali-English Vocabulary).
birth: n., dhalniin, -ti; give birth, dhal, umul; come to birth, dhalo.
bit: n., (small piece) in yar; bit of a bridle, xakame, -ihi, xilqaad (see curb).
bite: bite, v.tr., qaniin; v., is qaniin.
blameable: a.; he is blameable, nin la masabido weeye; thou art blameable, nin la masabido waa tahay.
blaspheme: v.tr. and v., Ilaah cay, Ilaah inkaar.
bleed: v.i., (lose blood) dhiig bax; my wound is bleeding, qoontayda dhiig ka baxayaa or ka imanayaa.
bleed, v.tr., (let blood) dhig ka sii daa.
bleeding: n., dhiig bax or bixi; bleeding of the nose, goror, -ki.
blister: n., gacanti biyo i galay, cagti waa i biyootay.
bloody: a., dhiig leh; a bloody man, nin laayaan ah.
blot: blot out, v.tr., baabi’i, bi’i, ka bi’i, tir, ka tir.
blow: n., (stroke) nabar, -ki; blow with the flat of a sword, ballad, -ki; blow with the fist, tantoomo, -adi, tumujo, -adi; blow with the hand, dharbaax, -adi.

blow, v.i., (to move with a current of air) dabayshi waa dhacaysaa, or dabayl baa ina haysa; blow with the mouth, v.tr., afuuf; blow with bellows, buufi; blow your nose, iska siimi or siinso, or siinka iska tir; (winnow) huf; blow out the lamp, siraadka bakhtii or sebi.
blunder: blunder, v.tr., khatal; v.i., khatalan, is khatal.
boar: n., doofaar, -ki, doofaar lab, doofaarki lab.
boat: n., (a small one) sexiimad or sixiimad, -di; (a large one) dooni, -di, baqlad, -di.
body: n., jidh, -ki; a dead body, mayd, -ki.
boil: boil: v.tr., kari; (to be agitated by heat) v., it boils, kar, distigii kar; the water boils, biyihii waa karayaan.
boiled: a., karsan; give me the boiled water, biyaha karsan i sii; boiled meat, hilib karsan.
boiler: n., (a kettle) digsi, -gi, disti, -gi, dheri, -gi, adar, -ki.
boiling: n., kar, -ki; a., give me boiling water, biya karaya i sii.
bold: a., geesi ah, qod ah, lab; n., geesi, -gi, rifay, -ihi, rifayaal (plural).
book: n., kitaab, -ki; the written or sacred book, cilmi, -gi.
border: n., (a selvage added to a skin dress) daruur, -ki; border of cloth, daraf, -ti, godi, -gi.
born: a., dhashay; a newborn boy, wiil dhowaan dhashay; be born, dhalo.
botch: n., (ulcer) boog, -ti; (a piece of cloth stitched to old clothes) karin, -ti.
both: prn., labadaba; on both sides, labada geesoodba.
bottle: bottle, v.tr.; bottle the wine, qaaruuradaha khamri ka buuxbuuxi.
bottom: n., daf, -ti, gun, -ti; bottom of a vessel, sal, -ki.
bough: n., (large shoot of a tree) laan, -ti.
bought: a., iibsan; be bought, iibsanaw; not bought, ma iibsana.
bounteous: a., deeqsi ah, nin deeqsi ah.
bow: n., (act of reverence) foorar or fooror, -ki, rakco, -di, sujuud, -di.
bow, v.tr., (bend) qallooci; bow your knees, jilba dhig; bow your head, madaxaaga foorori; bow your body, jidhkaaga qallooci or foorori.
bow, bow down, v.i., is foorori, foororso.
bowel: v.tr., uuslahaada kasoo bixi or difo or jiid or gur.
bowl: n., (vessel for drinking) fujaan or fijaan, -ki.
box: n., (of bark or a small one of wood...) abxad, -di; (wooden) saharad, -di, sanduuq, -i.
box, n., (blow given with the hand) tantoomo, -adi, tumuujo, -adi, dharbaaxo, -adi.
boy: n., wiil, -ki, inan, -ki, kuray, -gi, mudakar, -ki; little boy, ilmo, -ihi, ku yar, kii yaraa; boys, small boys, inamo, -adi, caruur, -ti, maqal, -shi, maqaldad, -ki.
bracelet: n., dugaagad, -di; wooden bracelet, haymboro, -adi; bracelet of silver, sindi, -gi, waqfi, -gi.
brag: brag, v.i., qawaysii; v.tr., qalaalif ku shub; v.c., qalaalif ka shub.
braid: braid, v.tr., (weave together) tidci; v.r., tidco.
braided: a., tidcan; the braided hair, timaha tidcan, timahii tidcanaa.
brambles: n., (in a valley beside a dry river) xid.
branch: n., laan, -ti; branches put in a tent during the time of rain, daragad, -di.
brand: n., qori dab leh, qoriga dabka leh; the brand, dhuxul dab leh, dhuxul dambas leh.
brand, v.tr., (mark with a branding-iron) gub.
brave: a., (nin) geesi ah, geesi, -gi, qod ah, lab, (nin) rag ah.
bray: (as asses), v.i., ci, madar; the ass brays, dameerku waa madaraa.
bread: n., kibis or kimis; hot-bread, kibis kulul; new bread, kibis diiran; stale bread, kibis qabow.
break: v.tr., burburi, bururi, jebi, break the stick, break the glass, jejebi usha, galaaska jebi; break the bottles, qaaruuradaha jejebi; break your neck, qoorta is jebi; break silence, waa hadli kartaan; break the wall down, derbiga burburi; break the eggs, ugaxaan bururi; break the eyes, isha ka bururi; break the picture, sawirka bururi; break open the door, albaabka burburiya or burbursha or jiida or iska jiida or ku dhufta; break the prison, xabsiga jebi; break (quell) that horse, faraska ii tababar or jarra bar; break his back, dabada kala dhac; break the head, dakhar, ka dhangalashi; (violate) kufso.

break: v.i., (burst) burbur, burur, jejeb, jab, ka jab; the ice breaks, barafku waa burburaa or jajabaa; the ice broke, barafki jejeb; the glass broke, galaaski jejeb or burbur; when the wave breaks, kolka mawjaddu burburto; I broke my leg, lug baan ka jabay (literally: I was broken of my leg); break your leg, lug ka jab; my eye burst, il baa i bururtay.
breath: n., neef, -ti; last breath, ugu dambays, -ti; shortness of breath, hinraag, -gi.
breed: v.tr., (produce) yeelo, dhal; that child is cutting teeth, inanka ilkihiisii baa usoo baxaya; (bring up) kori.
brew: v.tr., (to prepare, as a liquor, from several ingredients) qoosh, isku qoosh, isku dar.
bridge: n., (of the nose) sanqaroor, -ki; (of the sole) rays magado, -adi,
bring: v.tr., (fetch) keen, ka keen, gee, la kaalay; bring to me, bring to us, ii keen, noo keen or ii la kaalay, noo la kaalay; bring to him, her, them, u gee, or ula tag; bring me a coach, gaadhi ii keen; bring Ali with you, Cali soo kaxee; bring to light, dhal, yeelo; she brought a child into the world, inan bay ifka keentay; bring him into debt, qaan geli; bring into danger, cabsi geli; bring him to do it, ha falee waxaas u gee; bring back or again, soo celi; bring back to, u celi; bring to life again, noolee, soo nolaysii; bring away, sii qaad, soo saar, kasoo saar; bring the boy down, wiilka dafta usoo rog, or soo deji; bring forward, horo u keen, horo u jiid, horo usoo jiid; bring in, soo geli; bring here, halka keen, la kaalay, soo gur; bring out, tus, dibadda u saar; bring out your story, sheekadaada soo sar; bring that man out of trouble, war! ninka xumaanta ka bixi; he was brought forth before the time, shinku dhalad ma aha, or shinki ma dhalan, or shinki ma gaadhin; he was brought forth at his time, shinki ku dhalan; the she-camel brought forth a young one, hashi nerig bay abax ku dhashay or dhalatay or dhalisay: bring up (educate...) kori; help to bring up, la kori; be brought up, kor; be brought up with, la kor; your bad conduct will bring mischief upon you, asluubtaada xumi meel daran bay ka ridi or ka tuuri.
brink: n., (edge) fiiq, hi; brink of a mountain, jar, -ki; brink of a river, daan, -ki.
broil: v.tr., (dress meat on coals) dub, sool.
broken: a., burbursan; be broken, burbur, jab, jajab; a broken language, af burbursan, afki burbursanaa.
broke: v., (contract business for others) dilaal, dilaal noqo.
broom: n., minfiq, -di; (a piece of wood used as a broom) digahad, -ki.
brown: (colour), n. and a., maarriin, -ki; light brown, casuus leh, cowlan.
browse: v.i., daaq; the cow browses, lo’di waa daaqaysaa; the sheep browse, adhigi waa daaqayaa.
bucket: n., baaldi, -gi, barmiil yar; leathern bucket, nadh, -ki, wadaan, -ti; rope and bucket for drawing water, dowlis.
buckle: n., (a ring with a tongue) xadabo, -adi.
buffet: n., (a blow with the hand) dhirbaaxo or dharbaaxo, -adi.
build: v.tr., dhis, dhiso; build for, u dhis, aqalka u samee.
bunch: (bundle), n.; (a number of things tied together) guntin, -ti, xidhmo, -adi.
burn: n., (heat caused by fire) gubniin, -ti; burn made on sheep (brand), hanjid, -i.
burn: v.tr., gub; v.r., gubo; burn him alive, noolaanta ku gub; burn to ashes or carbonize, hurunshay; v.., gubo; he burns like fire, dab oo kaluu u gubanayaa.
burnt: a., guban; a burnt thing, hurunsho, -adi.
burr: n., (the round kotob of horn next to the deer's head) kod, -ki; burr of the ear (lobe), dahal, -shi; (upper part of the lobe) qurdan, -ki.
burrow: n., (hole made in the ground by rabbits) god, -ki.
burst: v.., qarax, burur, dilaac; v.tr., bururi.
bush: n., (thick shrub) xanan, -ki; a sour bush, daraan, -ti; a kind of bush with a milky sap, dibow, -gi.
bustard: n., ceelal joog or joog joog, -ti, salalmoodle, -lihi.
but: c., laakin, se (used as an affix).
butler: n., (servant in charge of liquors, head servant) budeer, -ki or ninka soorta Ferenjiga u dhiga.
butt: n., (mark to shoot at) qiyaas, -ti, duug, -ti; the butt end or extremity of a thing, caaro, -adi.
butter: n., burcad, -ki; melted butter, sixin, -ti; buttermilk, ciir, -ti.
buy: v.tr., iibi, soo iibi, iibso, soo iibso, soo sii, siiso, ka iibi.
by: prp., agta, geesta; by my side, agtaydii, geestaydii.
c: third letter of the English alphabet.
calf: n., (young of a cow) weyl, -ki; (in general) weylo, -ihi; (fleshy part of the leg behind, below the knee) muruq, -i.
call: call, v.tr., (to name) u bixi, ugu yeedh; (to invite) u yeedh; call after him, aad u yeedh; call again or back, soo celi; call aloud from, ka yeedh; call him aside, gooni ugu yeedh; call him out, away, dibadda u saar; call at that place, meesha sii mar; call back your word, hadalkaagi ku noqo; the governor calls for you, serkaalki baa kuu yeedhaya or doonaya; do you call for drink? ma waxaad cabtid baad doonaysaa? call for dinner, soorta hagaaji or soorta kala hagaaji; call forth, u yeedh; call in, soo geli; call in your money, lacagtaada ha kusoo gasho; call him off from that bad thing, ninka waxaa xun or dawga xun uga yeedh; I am called off from my studies, barashadaydi baa la iga yeedhay; call on, to, unto, upon, bari, dalbo; call him to help, caawimaad ugu yeedh; call over the names of the assembly, nin walba magiciisa ugu yeedh; call him to witness, marqaati ugu yeedh; call to remembrance, xusuusi; call together, iss u kaalaya; call him up in the morning, aroorta hore soo toosi.
calling to prayer, n., adimaad, -di, eedaan, -ki.
caller: n., (the man calling to prayer) muaddin, -ki, nin adimaya.
callousness: n., gandafil, -shi; calousness of the camel's hind legs, gorof leged, -ki; callousness of the camel's chest, shaf, -ki.
be callous, v.., gandafilow; my hand will become callous, gacanti i gandafilooday.
calumniate: v.tr., eeday, ku eeday, hafar, xano.
calumniator: n., nin eed badan, hafar badan, qabas, -ki.
camel: n., geel, -i, geelal, -shi (plur. com. gen.), awr, -ki (m.s.), awr, -ti (plur. com. gen.), rati, -gi (m.), hal, -shi (f.); (stallion) barqab, -ki; castrated camel, gool, -ki; a kind of large camel, koron, -ki; young camel, nirig, -gi (m.) -ti (f); young she camel, qaalin, -ti; camel-water-bearer, dhaan, -ki; not tamed, aymad, -ki, layli, -gi; camel without load, adaysimo, -adi; accustomed to carry loads, xamil qaad.
can: v.i., (be able) (defective and auxiliary verb) kar; he can read and write; waa aqri karaa oo qori karaa; I will do it if I can, waan samayn hadaan karo; he does all he can, wuxuu karo buu falaa; I cannot, ma karo, kari maayo; he cannot come, ma iman karo.
captive: n., (a prisoner of war) ninki dagaal baa lagu qabtay; naagti way la hadheen or naagtaasu waa la qabtay; (a slave) adoon, -ki, biday, -gi, bidad, -di.
cards: n., turub, -ki (sing. and plur.); play at cards, turub cayaar.
care: n., (solicitude, heed) fooyigan or foojigan, -ti, ilaalo, -adi; take care, iska eeg, ilaali jir, ogow; v.r., is jir, iska jir, is ogow.
care: v.., (be anxious); what care you? maxaad u dan leedahay or maxaad u foojigantahay? he cares for nobody, ninna dan uma leh.
careful: a., aamin ah, fooyig, feeyig or foojig; be careful, aamin ahaw.
cargo: n., maal, -ki, shexnad, -di; bring your cargo, soo nawil, shexnadda nawila.
carpet: n., firaash, -ki; a Somali carpet, kebed, -di.
carry: v.tr., (convey) qaad, sid, sido; carry for, u qaad, u sid; carry a child, xambaar; carry thy child, xambaaro ; carry yourself well, si wanaagsan u soco; he carries himself well, asluub tolmoon or wahan buu leeyahay; carry about you, sido; carry away, la tag, dibadda ula bax, carry away by force, ka dhifo; carry back, dib u celi; carry down, hoosta gee; carry out your design, damacaaga or dantaada wado; carry over the child, inanka durdurka ka talaabi.
cascade: cataract, n., biya garbaha kasoo duulay, garbo, -ihi.
case: n., (box) abxad, saharad, -di; judicial case, xujad, -di; case of complaint derived from any transgression of the Somali customs or traditions, xeer, -ki.
cash: (ready money), n. ; (of silver) shoola booli, -di; (of brass) cadadi, -di.
cast: v.tr., (throw) tuur, rid; cast a spear, waranka rid; cast yourself at his feet, hortiisa isku tuur; cast away, xoor; cast behind, dambaysii, daba jooji;  cast down, hoosaysii; cast headlong, madaxa u tuur, soo weydhafi.
castaway: n., (rejected) nin inkaaran, nin la nacay.
caste: n., xigaal, -ki, qolo, -adi, tol, -ki; the high castes, gob, -ki; the low castes, sab, -ti; the three low castes: tumaal, -ki, midgaan, ki, yibir, -ki.
castrated: u., dhufaanan, tuman; a gelded animal, dugaag tuman.
cat: n., bisad, -di, dinnad, -di; male cat, curri, -gi; wildcat, dinnad habishi; civet cat, dinnad sabad, -di; small cat, dinnad yar.
cataplasm: n., (a poultice) dhamooq, -i; apply a cataplasm, dhamooq.
catch: v.tr., (hold on to) qabo, qabso, xiji; catch hold of, ka qabo, ka qabso; catch with, ku qabso; catch the truth, runta qab; the wood will catch fire, alwaaxdu way guban; he has caught a distemper, cudur buu qaaday or qabsaday or wuu bukooday.
cattle: n., xoolo nool, -ki, foof, -ki, dareer, -ki, soof, -ki; neat or black cattle, lo', -di.
cause: cause, v.c., this is expressed by using the causative form of the verb (see Gram.).
caw: v.i., (cry as the rook) ci or ci’.
certain: a., (sure) la hubaa; certain news, war la hubo; it is certain, waa dhab, waa run, waa la hubaa; be certain, hub; make certain, dhabay, kaga dhabee, rumay, run la hubaa sheeg.
certain, a., (some one) hebel, wax ba.
certify: v.tr., (assure) dhabee, fur, marqaati ku fur, rumay.
chafe: n. (heat caused by rubbing) gomod, -ki; (rage, fury) cadho, -adi.
chafe, v.tr., (make hot) kululay; (make angry) kaga cadhaysii; (make warm by rubbing) gomodi.
chafe, v.i., (rage) cadho; (to be sore or galled by riding) gomod.
chain: n., silsilad; of mountains, buuro isku yaal, buuraha isku yaal, buuraha garbohooda.
chain, v.tr., (tie with chains) silsilad ku xidh or ku jebi.
challenge: n., (invitation to fight) daandaansid or daandaansi, -ki; (a demand for something due) digniin, -ti, qanan, -ki.
challenge, v.tr, (call to fight) daandaanso; (claim) qanan, ninki digniin u dir.
champ: v.tr. and v.i., (chew, bite) calasho; the horse champs his bit, farasku xakamihi yuu calaashanayaa.
change: n., (alteration, novelty) bedalaad, -di; change of money, sarrif, -ki.

change (a thing), v.tr.; (barter, exchange) dhaafi, is dhaafi, dhaafso, doori, doorso; change money, sarrif; chenge your shirt, qamiiskaaga iska dhig oo mid kale gasho or huwo; change your hat with mine, koofiyadaada tayda i dhaafi or igu doori
chap: n., (chink, cleft) dilaac, -i; chap of the ground, bohol, -shi; chap of the skin, safan, -ki.
character: n., (mark) sumad, -di; an indelible character, sumad aan weligeed bi’in; (personal qualities, particular constitution of mind) camal, -ki.
charge: n., (custody, care) ilaalo, -adi; (burden) xamil, -ki, rar, -ki, rarmo, -adi.
charm: n., (words or characters imagined to have some magical power) faal, -ki; (amulet) xirsi, -di, qardhaas, -ti, macfo, -adi.
cheap: a., (at a low rate) jaban, ganac jaban; rice is cheap, bariiski jeb; sell cheap, v.tr., ganac jaban, or yar sii, or ku iibi; buy cheap, ganac jaban soo sii, or ku iibi.
cheat: n., (deceit, fraud) xadhig, -gi, dulun, -ki, xeelad, -di, khiyaan, -ki, khayaano, -adi.
cheat, v.tr., (defraud) dhac, dulun, khayaanay, khiyaanee.
cheater: n., nin dulun ah, xadhig badan, khiyaan ah, khayaano leh.
cheek: n., can, -ki, dhaban, -ki; chubby cheek, can buur, -ki.
cheer: cheer, v.tr., (make cheerful) kaga badhaadhi, kaga rayraysii, kaga badhbadhaadhi; (grow cheerful) v.i., badhaadh, ray, rayray.
chest: n., (a wooden box) saharad, -di, sanduuq, -i; (breast) laab, -ti.
chew: v.tr., (masticate) calali, calasho, raabso; chew the cud, v.i., (ruminate) calalnaqso.
chewing: n., calal, -ki, calalis, -ki, raabsi, -gi; chew cud, calalnaqsi, -gi.
chief: n., (a commander) caaqil or caaqal, -ki, garaad, -ki, ugaas, -ki; (chieftain, leader) abbaanduule, -ihi; chief in a government office, taliye, -ihi, xaakin, -ki; vice-chief, guddi, -di, -gi.
child: n., caruur, -ti, dhalaan, -ki (sing. and plur.), da’ yar, -di, -ayd, ku yar, kii yaraa, ilmo, -ihi; chubby child, ilma kobcay; sucking child, ilma naasaha jaqa; spoiled child, ilma daalim ah; corrupted child, ilma xun.
chill: chilly, a., dhaxamooday, nin dhaxamooday; be chill, dhaxamow, or dhaxamood.
chink: chink, v., (to sound by striking each other) danan; the money shines and chinks, lacagtu waa dhalaashaa oo danantaa.
chip: n., (a small piece of wood) qanfaf, -ki, qanshar, -ki, qushaash, -ki.
chip and chop, v.tr., (cut into small pieces) googoo, jarjar.
chirp: n., (the voice of birds) ci or ci’, -di.
chirp, v., i; the bird chirps, shimbirtu waa cidaa.
choice: n., door, -ki, doorasho, -adi; I leave it to your choice, wa adigi iyo doorashadaa; it is in my choice, anigaa doorashada leh, or aniga doorashada baan leeyahay.
choke: v.tr., (suffocate) cabudh, siriri; v.r., joogso; be choked, cabudhan.
choose: v.tr., doori, dooro, ka dooro, ka naqay, ka naqayso, ka xulo.
chowter: v., (grumble) gunuus; that child does nothing but chowter, wiilkaasi wax kale ku arki maysid aan gunuus ahayn.
Christ: (the Saviour of the world), n., Kiristos.
circle: n., goobo, -adi, goobaabin, -ti; make a circle, goobee, goobaabi.
circulate: v., ku wareeg; the blood circulates, dhiiggu waa dalalaa, money should circulate, lacagtu or lacagi waa wareegi lahayd.
circumcise: v.tr., gud, balagta ka goo, haranta ka goo, buuryada ka goo, xalaalay.
circumstances: n., (state, condition) dan, -ti; I am in better circumstances, dantaydi hore ka roon yaan wataa.
claim: v.tr., gar u sheego, qanan sheego; give the things he claims, gar mari, gar sii.
clamour: n., (bustle) buuq, -i, bulxan, -ki, -ti (for the past), gurxan, -ki, sawaxan, -ki, dhawaaq, -i, qaylo, -adi.
clang: n., (a sharp noise) bikel or bigil, -ki.
clap: (your hands), v.tr., saabada isku dhifo or dhufo, dhirbaax.
clap, n., dharbaaxo or dhirbaaxo, -adi, saab, ki; (crack) bac, -di.
clash: v.., (strike one against another) is tun, is jiid.
clay: clay, v.tr., (cover with clay) dhoob, dhoobay, dhoobo ku dhoob.
clean: a., adaysan, safaysan, saafi ah, maydhan, miiran, nadiifsan.
clean, cleanse, v.tr., cadee, safee, xal, maydh, maydho, tir, ka tir, iska tir, nadiifi, nadiif ka dhig; clean up, qor.
clear: a., miiran, saafi ah; a clean day, wa dharaar dhalaalaysa.
clear, v.tr., (make bright) cadee, miir; clear a business, difficulty, hagaaji, wanaaji; clear the account, xisaabta hagaaji; be clear, miiran.
cleft: n., (a crevice) bohol, -shi, dilaac, i, jeex, -i.
clever: a., wax yaqaan, fiican, fariid ah, farsamo badan, fariid, -ki, fiic, -i; be clever, fiicanaw.
client: (of a man in power), n., singal, -ki, deris, -ki.
climb: v.tr. and v.i., (ascend) fuul, kor, dusha u bax, ka bax, buurta ka bax.
clip: v.i., (to swallow words) qudhqudhi; you swallow the words, adigu hadalkaaga waa qudhqudhisaa.
clod: n., (a lump of earth) fud carra ah, -ki, carradaaha.
close: close, v.tr., (shut) abudh, xidh; close in, ku xidh.
cloth: clothes, n., dhar, -ka; here I have meat, clothes and drink, halkan ku haystaa cunnadi iyo dharki iyo biyihiiba.
clothe: v.tr., huwi, wax u geli; v.r., huwo, gasho.
clutch: v.tr., (hold in the hand) ka dhifo.
coach: n., gaadhi, -gi; coach horse, faras gaadhi jiida, -ki, gaadhigi jiidi jiray; coach man, gaadhiwale, -hi.
coal: n., dhuxul, -shi; live or burning, dhuxul nool.
coffee: n., (berry) bun, -ki; coffee husks, qashir or qashar, -ki, qahwa, -ihi; coffee pot, ibriiqa qahwa ah; Arabic coffee, jemelad, -di; coffee shop, maqaayad, -di; coffee house keeper, maqaawi, -gi.
cohabit: v., (ninka) la joog; wada jooga (plur.); we cohabit, waannu wada joognaa.
cold: coldness, n., dhaxan, -ti, qabow, -gi; severe cold, gabadano, -adi; disease caused by cold, duray, -gi; cold fit, qadhqadhyo, -di; take or catch a cold, dhaxamow, dhaxan qaad; I caught a cold, duray baan qaaday.
collect: v.tr., isu gee, isu keen, uruuri, kusoo gur.
comb: n., (man's) fidhin, -ki; comb for the beard, gadh feedh, -ki; woman's comb, saqaf, -ti.
comb, v.tr., feedh, feedho, isu feedho.
come: v.i., imoo, (commonly) kaalay; how comes that? war! Waxaas maxaa sidaas ka dhigay? or war! waa sidee saasi? come about, kusoo wareeg; come again, come back, soo noqo, soo laaban; come after, raadi, raad gur; come along, soo raac; come along the shore, xeebta soo raac; come away, kasoo bax, ina keen; come by, soo mar; come down, soo deg, hoosta kaalay, soo dhaadhac; come down from, ka soo deg; come for, u kaalay; come forth, soo bax; come forward, wad; come from, ka kaalay; come in, soo gal; come in for, usoo gal; come into, ka dhac; come into trouble, jar ka dhac; come near, soo dhowow, soo durug; come next, ku xig; that comes of my doing, waxaasi waxay waxaa ku noqdeen waa wax anigu aan sameeyay, or kaasu wa shuqulkaygii; how did you come off? war! sidee usoo baxsatay? do you think to come off so? war! ninyohow sidaa ku baxsan maysid ha moodin, or ma u malaynaysaa inaad sidaa ku baxsatid? my hair comes off, timahaygaa soo hoday; the moon comes out, dayixi waa kasoo baxayaa; come to, soo soco, soo gaadh, gaadh; come to me, isoo gaadh or bax; he came to a shameful end, si xun buu u dhintay; it came to pass, waxay noqotay; come to and fro, soo noqo, sii noqo; come together, isa soo raaca; come with, soo raac; come life, come death, I will go alone, ama aan dhinto, ama aan noolaado, keligay baan socon; come between, soo dhexee, noo dhexee, soo na dhex gal; come quick, soo dhaqso, soo orod; come up, soo kor, dusha u kaalay, dusha usoo bax; let come, soo daa; when old age comes upon you, you cannot do anything, markaad da’ weyn gaadhid, or markaad odayowdid waxba ma kari doontid.
command: commandment, n., xukun, -ki, qaynuun, -ki, hawl, -ki, wasiyad, -di.
command, v.tr., (order) xukun, -ki; v.., (have the supreme authority) ka sarree,
commend: v.tr., (praise) amaan; everybody commends him, nin waliba waa amaanaa; (commit) amaan; commend your spirit to God, naftaada Ilaahay ku amaan or amaanayso.
commit: v.tr., (intrust) amaan, amaanayso, amaano u dhiib; I committed that business to you, shuqulkaas adaan kuugu amaanaystay; (do, perpetrate) fal.
communicate: v.tr., la hadal, ogaysii, u sheeg, war sii, u warran.
communion: n., (union in the common worship or faith) isku daran, -ki; (participating in the blessed sacrament) tanaawil, -ki.
complain: v.i., (lament) barooro, xasuuso, muusanaw; complain in law, ashtakee, ashtako, gar sheego, gar u sheego, garran, la garran.
complaint: n., (a lament) baroor, -ti, xasuus, -ti, muusanaw, -gi; complaint in law, ashtako, -di, gar, -ti.
complete: complete, a., dhan, dhami, dhamayd, idil, idli, leyl, leyli.
comprehensive: a., eraygaas waa la garan karaa.
compress: v.tr., (force into a narrow compass) diis, ku diis, tuuji.
conceive: v.tr. and v.., (be pregnant) dhal, yeelo.
condemn: v.tr., (ninka) u tali; the judge condemned me, ninki dawladeed baa igu gareeyay; God will condemn you, Eebbahay wuu ku cadaabi.
confine: v.i., (limit); Somaliland confines Abysinia, dhul Soomaaliyeed, dhul Xabashiyeed buu ku yaal or ku idlaadaa; v.tr., (shut up) xidh.
confirm: v.tr., (put past doubt) dhabay, rumay; (strengthen) adkay.
conform with: v.i., oggolaw; conform to the will of God, talada Eebbahay oggolaw.
congeal: v.tr., fadhiisi; v.i., the milk congeals, caanihii fadhiistay.
congratulate: v.tr., I came to congratulate you, inaan adiga kaaga badhaadhiyo yaan u imi.
congregate: v.tr., uruuri, so uruuri, isugu keen, isugu geyn.
conjure: v.tr., dalbo, ka doon, ka doono ; conjure up, faal; (exorcise) ka sar, eeri.
consecrate: v.tr., qudus ka samee or ka dhig.
consider: v.tr., (examine) hubso, tasho, calooshaada la tasho.
consist: v., (subsist); God is before all things, and by him all things consist, Ilaah baa wax walba ugu horeeya, oo wax waliba isagay ku nool yihiin; our life consists in the union betwixt the body and the soul, noolaanteenu waa jidhkeena iyo nafteena isku yaal; the land consists of plains, valleys and mountains, berrigu waa banaan iyo faro iyo buuro.
consolidate: v.tr., adkay, taag, ad u taag.
constipated: a., calool ingegan, nin calool ingegan leh.
consult: v.tr. and v.i., la faq, weydii, weydiiso; consult your strength, itaalkaaga la tasho.
consume: v.tr., baabi’i, lumi; time consumes everything, goor baa wax walba baabi’isa.
contemptible: a., fudud, gun; contemptible person, gumays, -ti.
contest: v.tr. and v.i., (dispute) hala heshiin, ha heshiinina (plur.); we will contest, innagu ma heshiin doonno.
continue: v.tr. and v.i., hor u soco, wad.
contract: v.tr., (shorten) gaabi, yaree, yaraysii; get or contract a disease, cudur baa kugu dhici; contract a bad habit, asluub xun baa kugu dhici.
contradict: v.i., (not to keep your word) hadalkaaga beenee; (oppose verbally) asaraar.
contradictor: n., (nin) asaraar badan, asaraar weyn, asaraar miidhan ah.
contumacy: n., (a wilful disobedience to any summons) diidniin, -ti.
convict: v.tr., (prove guilty) ku garray; be convicted, ka gar hel, garrow.
convoke: convocate, v.tr., soo uruuri; convoke to that place, meeshaas isugu gee, rag oo dhan u yeedh.
cook: cooked, a., bisil; not cooked, ma bisla, ceedhiin, ceedhiin ah.
cool: cool, v.tr., (make cool) qabowji; v.i., (grow cool) qabow; v.r., qaboojiso.
copulation: n., (coupling) galmo, -adi, warmo, -adi; copulation of camels, abaaho, -adi; copulation of neat cattle, ofno, -ihi.
copulate: v.tr., (couple) u kaxay ha oofiyayee; v.i., saaro.
cork: cork, v.tr., (stop with a cork) abudh.
cornea: n., indhaha caloosheeda cad, hayd, -di; cornea of the eye, isha haydeeda.
corrupt: v.tr., (spoil) qudhmi, ka bi’i, dil, u xumay; (become rotten) v.i., qudhun.
council: n., shir, -ki; go to the council, shirka tag.
courageous (man): a., geesi, -gi, geesi ah, kelliya badan, kelliya leh, bili leh.
cover: v.tr., (overspread) huwi; v.r., huwo, dabool; cover with the sheet, ded; cover the head to warm him, huuri; cover the face to hide him, u hagoog, u hagooji; v.r., u hagoogo; cover with the shield, gabo.
cover, n., (anything used to cover) dabool, -ki; cover of a boiler, dabool dheri, sab, -ki.
cow: n., sac, -hi; herd of cows, lo', -di; a milch cow, irmaan, -ki; gabaan, -ki, sac gabaan ah, cow no longer milked, qaan, -ki.
crack: crack, v., (burst, split) burur, dilaac, qarax.
cramp: n., (spasm or contraction of the nerves) kabuuliyo, -adi.
crawl: v.i., (creep) beerka ku soco, bogga ku soco.
create: v.tr., abuur, uun; be created, abuuran, uumanow.
credit: n., (belief) aamin, -ki; (reputation) maamuus or naamuus, -ti; taking on credit, deyn, -ki.
creed: n., (faith) aamin, -ki, aaminaad, -di; (rule of faith) qaynuunka aaminaadda; the Apostles' Creed, qaynuunka rasuulyada.
crepuscle: n., fiid, -ki, maqrib, -ki, gabbal dhac, dhici.
cripple: n., (person) orjujun, -ki, laxaad la’, -ki, -a, lug la’aan; congenital cripple, alan, -ki, alanad, -di; cripple by accident or sickness, curyaan, -ki, curyaanad, -di.
crook: crooked, a., qalloocan; a man with crooked legs, nin luga qalloocan, or nin dalba leh, I have seen the woman with crooked legs, naagtii dalbaha lahayd baan arkay.
crookedness, n., qallooc, qalqallooc, -i; crookedness of the legs, dalbo, -ihi.
cross: n., saliib, -ki, isku talaab, -ti; make a cross, isku talab samee.
cross, a., (peevish) isku talaabsan, xun, wax yeela badan.
cross, v.tr., (lay, or go across) ka talaab, dhex mar, weydaaro; v.c., weydaari; why do you cross me thus? maxaad sidaas iiga xanuujinaysaa?
crown: n., (of hair, left on girls) xerar, -ki.
crupper: n., (for a camel's saddle) daba gelis, -ki.
cry: n., (clamour) dhawaaq, -i, qaylo, -adi, ci, -di, oor, -ki; (lamentation) baroor, -ti, muusanow, -gi, oyn, -ki.
cry, cry out, cry aloud, v.i., qayli, ci, dhawaaq, oori, yeedh; (weep) barooro, muusanow, oy; v.c., kaga baroori, kaga oy; cry the auction of the camels, iibka geela la iibinayo ku dhawaaq.
cudgel: n., (a heavy stick) haray or hare, -ihi.
cup: n., (a small drinking vessel) fujaan or finjaan, -ki.
cup, v.tr., (to bleed by scarification and a cupping-glase) toob.
cupping-glass, or the horn (cornet) used in the place of it, toobin, -ki.
cupper, nin wax tooba, naag wax toobta; the cupper, ninki wax toobi jiray, naagti wax toobi jirtay.
curb: n., (part of a bridle) durmad, -di, hilqad, -di.
curd: n., (coagulated part of milk) gadhoodh, -ki.
cure: n, (restoration to health) bogsiis, -ki, bogsiin, -ti, boski, -gi.
cure, v.tr., (restore to health) bogsii; be cured, bogso; he is cured, bogsaday.
curious: a., gulawaa, -ihi, fuduul badan, fuduuli ah, fuduuli, -gi.
curl: curl, v.tr., (form into ringlets) marooji, maroori, sooh.
curry: v.tr., (dress leather) yeel naq; (a kind of sauce used in India) sanuunad, -di, (see kahri in Supplement.).
curse: n., habaar, -ki, inkaar, -ti, naclad, -di or nacdal, -shi.
curse: v.tr., habaar, inkaar, nacdal; v.i., Ilaah cay, Ilaah inkaar.
cursed: a., habaaran, habaar qaba, inkaaran, inkaar qaba, naclad qaba.
cut: cut, v.tr., goo, jar; cut into two parts, kala goo or goy; cut into many parts, googoo, kala googoo; cut into small pieces (chop), kidif; cut the skin, sar, sarsar; cut meat, qal; v.r., is goo; cut for yourself, gooso, googooso; be cut, goo.
daily: ad., goor or kol walba; every day, casho or maalin walba.
dam: n., (a mole, a bank) deer, -ki, xer, -ki.
damn: v.tr., (condemn to eternal torments in the future world) cadaab; a damned man, nin la cadaabay.
dance: n., cayaar, -ti; a kind of dance, sacab, -ki.
dance, v., (move with measured steps) cayaar; v.c., cayaarsii.
dangerous: a., cabsi leh; not dangerous, cabsi la’, shil la’.
dare: v.., (be not afraid of) ha biqin, sababo; do not dare, ka xishoo, baq.
dark: dark, a., gudcur, gudcur ah, madowbaa.
date: n., (time of an event) ayaan, -ti; (the fruit of the date tree), timir, -ti; nice and clean date, barni, -di, xallaawi, -gi, sacmaran, -ti; wild dates, maydo, -adi.
daughter: n., inan, -ti; the daughter of Ali, ina Cali.
dawn: n., (the break of day) arooryo, -adi, gabbal soo bax, -ki, soo bex.
day: n., casho, -adi, ayaan, -ti, dharaar, -ti, maalin, -ti, caana maal, -ki, maanta; day and night, habeen iyo dharaar; make that in the day, dharaarti waxaa fal; a holiday, ayaan, -ti; Sunday is not a work day, Axaddi ayaan hawleed ma aha; day by day, maalin walba; the next day, the following day, maalinta dambe, maalintan soo socota; the third day, or the day after to-morrow, saa dambe; every other day, maalin dhaaf; today, this day, maanta, dharaarta, maalinta; all the day long, maantoo leyli; the day before yesterday, dorraad; this many a day, beri hore waxaa jiray; this day week, maalintan todobaadkeeda; the day after the day after to-morrow, saakub or saakun.
dead: a., nin go’ay, naag go’day; he is dead, go’; the dead men, dadkii dhintay.
death: n., dhimad, -ki, dhimasho, -adi, geeri, -di, moot, -ki; (for beasts) bakhti, -gi.
debauchee: n., nin ambabay or lumay or lunsan or is lumiyay.
decay: v.i., (decline); his strength decays, itaalkiisa waxba ka dhaca.
deceit: n., (fraud) khiyaan, -ki, khiyaano, --adi, khayaan, -ki, qalqaal, -ki, qawaayad, -ki.
deceive: v.tr., khiyaanay, khayaanay, qawaysi, qalqaal, khatal, duufi, duufso.
deceived: a., (man) nin la khayaaneeyay, qalqaalan; be deceived, v.i., qaaway, khatalan.
decide: v.tr., (determinc) dacwadda noo mari; decide our dispute, qoonsigayaga ku tali.
decrease: v.tr., din, hoosaysii, yaree; (grow less) dhiman.
decree: n., (edict) xukun, -ki; what God has decreed, we must submit to, waxa Eebbahay ina yidhaahdo inaynu yeellaa baynu leenahay.
defend: v.tr., (protect) ka celi, karaw; v.r., is karaw, iska guluf.
defer: v.tr., (refer to) gaabi, raaji; v.i., gaab, raag.
defy: v.tr., (challenge) daandaanso; you must never defy a fool, nin waalan ha daandaansan.
deject: v.tr., (cast down) ka qulbi, qulubsi; be dejected, wahan, qulub, qulubsanaw.
dejected: a., qulubsan, nin wahamay or ruxmay.
delay: delay, v.i., raag, gaab; v.tr., raaji, gaabi.
delight: delight, v.tr, (please) ka farxi, raaxaysii, rayraysi; v.i., (take delight in) farxi, raaxo, raaxayso, rayray, badhaadh.
deliver: v.tr., (give) bixi; (set free) iska sii daa; deliver up, magaalada iska bixi.
delivery: deliverance, n., (of goods) dhiibniin, -ti; (birth of a child) umusho, -adi.
demand: v.tr., (ask) su’aal, weydii, weydiiso; (claim) qanan, sheego.
demon: n., (a spirit) jini or jinni, -gi; (the devil) shaydaan, -ki.
denial: n., (negation, refusal) dafiraad, -di, diidniin, -ti; self-denial, is necbaan, -ti.
denouncer: delator, denunciator, n., deen ka tuur, -ki.
deny: v.tr., dafir, diid, hala heshiin, ha yeelin; he denied his God, Ilaahiisuu dafiray.
depart: v.., tag, ka tag, guur; when he departed, goortuu guuray or tagay.
depart, departure, departing, n., guurniin, -ki, tegniin, -ki.
deposit: deposit, v.tr., amaan, amaano u dhiib, amaano ku reeb.
deprive: v.tr., (take off) ka qaad, farxad isu diid; be deprived, calaacal, dacanaw ha laga qaado, beel.
descend: v.i., deg, soo deg, kasoo deg.
descent: n., (coming down) degniin, -ti; (process of lineage) qolo, -adi.
desert: n., cid la’, -di, cidla’ ciirsila’, -di, miyi, -gi; a., cidla’, cidla ah.
despair: n., (loss of hope) quusad, -ki; v.i., quuso, iska quuso.
despoil: v.tr., ka xad, ka qaad, rog.
detain: v.tr., (stop, keep) jooji; detain him prisoner, ninkaa xabsiga ku raaji; (hinder) u dhib.
determine: v.tr., (decide) (waxaas) ku tali; (influence the choice) ugu tali; v.i., damac.
deviate: v.i.; reason often deviates, miyirku qajeyla dawga wanaagsan buu ka duwaa.
dewlap: n., (flesh hanging down from the throat of oxen) cal, -shi or cad, -di, macal, -shi.
diarrhoea: n., dabaxaw, -di; this man has diarrhoea, ninkaasi dabaduu ka baxayaa.
difference: n., (disparity) kala mid, -di; (dispute), what is the difference? maxaa idin dhexeeya?
diminish: v.tr., dhin, gaabi, yaray, yaraysii, yarayso.
dip: v.tr., (immerge) quusi, dar, soo dar; (wet) qoy.
direct: direct, v.tr., toos u wad, toos u kaxay; direct that letter to the governor, warqaddaa serkaalka u gey or ku toosi.
dirt: n., uskag, -gi, wasakh, -i, nijaas, -ti, sabooh, -di, dooro, -adi; dirt of the teeth, huuro, -adi.
dirt, dirty, v.tr., (foul) uskagay, wasakhay, sabay.
dirty: a., uskag leh, uskagaysan, wasakhaysan, nijaas ah, dooro weyn, sabooh badan.
disappointed: a., nin luggo’ay; be disappointed, luggo’.
disarm: v.tr., furo, ninka furo, hubka ka qaad.
discern: v.i.; between truth and falsehood, run iyo been kala sooc.
discharge: v.tr., (unload) fur, kasoo gur, kasoo rog; v.r., ka bax; (dismiss) eeri.
discontent: a., werwersan; be discontented, werwer; v.tr., werweri.
discourage: v.tr., (dispirit) qulubsi, ka qulbi; be discouraged, ruxan.
discourse: n., hadal, -ki, haasaaway, -ihi; religious discourse, masalo, -adi.
discover: v.tr., (disclose) fur, ka qaad, daboolka ka qaad; (make known) ogaysii; (find out) hel.
discretion: n., fiicnaan, -ti, foojigaan, -ti; age of discretion, garaad, -ki.
discussion: n., (debate) masalo, -adi; an aggressive discussion, qoonsi, -gi.
disease: n., bukaan, -ki, cudur, -ki; contagious disease, sabooh, -di, disease of cows, sambab, -ki; disease of sheep, mindhiciris dab; disease of lambs, haqley; disease of kids, jaqle; disease of sheep and goats, dhogor rugmad, -ki.
disembark: v.i., deg, soo dhaadhac; v.tr., deji, kasoo deji, rog, kasoo rog, kasoo dhaadhici, kasoo gur.
disgrace: discredit, dishonour, n., xishood, -ki; v.tr., ceebay, xil.
disguise: v.tr., midab doori or rog; v.r., is doori.
disgust: n., yiqyiqsi, -gi, balaf, -ki; v.tr., kaga yiqyiqsi.
disgusted: a., yiqyiqsooday; be disgusted, yiqyiqso, nac.
dish: n., (a vessel) weel, -ki, sexni, -gi; dish of wood, xeedho, -adi; large dish, xeedho ballaadhan; small dish, qoobad, -di.
dislike: n., ma jeclaan, -ti; dislike of food, balaf, -ki; v.tr., ha jeclaan, balfi.
dismay: n., (fright) baqdin, -ti, naxadin, ti; v.tr., baji, kaga nixi.
disobey: v.tr., caasi, diid, ha maqlin, ha yeelin.
display: v.tr., (exhibit to sight or mind) tus, ogaysii, muuji.
distance: n., fogaan, -ti; a short distance, oodrogad, -ki.
distant: a., fog, shishay; a distant place, meel fog.
distinct: a., soocan, kala soocan, kala mid.
divorced: a., furan; a woman, nag furan.
dizziness: n., (whirl in the head) madax wareer, -ki.
dizzy: a., qof maduxu wareerayo; (make giddy) wareeri.
do: v.tr., fal, samay, yeel; all is done, gidi dhamaaday; I know not what to do with them, anigu waxaan ku falo garan maayo.
