down: down: prp. and ad., dhaaf, -ta, hoos, -ta; fall down, ku dhac; go down the hill, buurta hoos uga deg, or buurta dhaaf, or buurta hoos u dhaaf; go down the stream, durdurka sii raac; come down, soo deg, kasoo deg; lie down, jiifso; sit down, fadhiiso; the wind is down, dabayshi dhacday; the moon is down, dayixi dhec; the sun is down, qoraxdi dhacday; up and down, dul iyo hoos, dushiyo hoostaba warwareeg; get down, dhaadhac; make him get down, soo dhaadhici.
downcast: a., (dejected) nin ruxmai; be downcast, ruxan.
dozen: n., derjin, -ki; a dozen of eggs, derjin ugaxan ah.
dragon: n., mas duula, mas laayaan ah.
drain: v.tr., (draw off water) biyaha gudhi or goo or liq.
draught: n., (drinking at once) cantuugo, -adi; I drank it at a draught, cantuugo keli aan ku liqay.
draw: v.tr., (pull) jiid, jiidjiid, soo or sii jiid, soo jiidjiid, kasoo bixi; draw up water, dowli; draw back, dib u celi, dib u noqo; the night draws on, habeenki waa soo socdaa; my fate draws nigh, geridaydi waa soo socotaa or dhowdahay; (represent by picture) sawir.
dread: dread: dreadful, a., cabsi leh, laga cabso, laga boqo.
dream: n., dhadhab, -ki, riyo, -adi, riyood, -ki, tamanta, -ihi; v.i., dhadhab, riyoo.
dress: n., (cloth) dhar, -ki; Somali, maro, -adi, haili, -gi; v.tr., huwi, qamiiska u geli; dress yourself, huwo, gasho.
drink: v.tr., cab, dhan, fuud; v.c., cabsii, dhansii; drink liquors, wine, isku dhufo; do you drink wine? ma isku dhufataa?
drive: v.tr., (guide) jiid; drive away, off, eeri; (compel) ku eeri; drive the nail in the table, musmaarka miiska ku eeri; drive out, ka eeri.
drizzle: drizzling rain, n., cadar, -ki; it drizzles, cadar da’, or cirku waa cadar da’aya.
drop: n., dhibic, -di, tifiq; -a, drop of water, tifiq biya ah.
drown: v.tr., hafi; v.r., is hafi; be drowned, hafo.
drowsy: (sleepy), a., (nin) hurda, damadsan, gama'san, lulo badan.
drunk: a., saqraansan, liqsan; be sakhraan; make him drunk, kaga saqraami; make yourself drunk, isku dhufo.
dry: a., qalalan, ingegan; be dry, qalal, ingeg; v.tr., qalaji, qalali, ingeji.
due: a.; it is money - lacagtan amaah baa la igu leeyahay; come in time, goor goor ah kaalay, or goor wanaagsan kaalay; that letter is written in due form, warqadaas si wanaagsan baa la qoray; n., give everyone his due, nin walba waxiisa hala siiyo; we must give the devil his due, shaydaanka wuxuu leeyahay aan siino.
dull: a., qulabsan, doqon, -ki, silcan (for work); to make dictionaries is a dull work; isku daranka erayada waa shuqul silcan.
dumb: a., (mute) carrabla’; deaf and dumb, carrab iyo dhegaba la’, or carrab iyo dhega la’.
dung: n., (excrement) xaar, -ki, saxaro, -adi, uus, -ki; of camels, horses and cattle, faanto, -adi, fulul, -ki (when dry) and falti, -di (when liquid); of camels, sheep and goats, saalo, -adi.
dust: n., amud, -di, habaas, -ki, sesa or sisa, -di, siigo, -adi, sufur, -ti.
dying: a., (expiring) nin dhimanaya; he is in a dying state, waa nin hai kasii baxaysa.
dysentery: n., dabadig, -ti, xundhur, -ti; dysentery of horses and cattle, darfac, -hi.
haft: n., (a handle) daab, -ki; v.tr., daabka ku dheji.
hail: n., (frozen rain) dhagax roob, roobka dhagixiisi (the hail); (health!) salaam! hail to you! salaam caleekum! war caafimaad!
hair: n., tin, -ki, timo, -ihi; hair of animals, dhogor, -ti; hair of the tail, gameello, -adi.
half: (½), n., badh, -ki, jeex; (part) go’, -i; half a glass, half a pot, mugii.
halloo: int., car! car! war! war hoy!
hallow: v.tr., (make holy) qudus u samee, qudus ka dhig; be hallowed, samow.
halt: n., (a stop during a march) joog, -gi; v.tr., joog, joogso; halt at night, hooyo.
halter: n., (of a camel) hogaan, -ki; (of a horse) jare, -ihi, shakamad, -di.
hand: n., gacan, -ti; the right hand, midigta; the left hand, bidixda; he has a hand in it, gacan buu kula jiraa; my hand is in, gacan baan kula jiraa; my hand is out, gacan kula ma jiro; he is my right hand, waa gacantayda midig; the two men go hand in hand, labada nin waa isku gacan; handwriting, far, -ti.
hand: v.tr., (give) u dhiib; you handle the oar well, sebka aad baad u waddaa.
handsome: a., qurux badan, or qurux wanaagsan, baxsan, shuban.
hang: v.tr., deldel, calaq; v.i., (be suspended) laalaad, ka laalaad.
happen: v.., noqo; it happens, waxay noqotaa; so it happened, sidaasay noqotay.
hard: a., adag, xoog badan, kulul; hard working men have hard skins, nimanka shaqeeya waa duub adag yihiin; ad., it grows hard, waa adkaanaysaa; strike him hard, si adag ugu dhufo; the wind blows hard, dabayshu aad bay u dhacaysaa.
hard-hearted: (man), a., nin calool adag, ninkii caloosha adkaa (the ...).
hare: n., bakayle, -ihi; hare-lipped man, nin faruuran.
harm: n., wax yeello, -adi; v.tr., u xumay, qoon yeel.
hate: hatred, n., necbaan, -ti; feeling of hate, uur ku taalo, -adi.
hawk: n., haadka adag, -ti; species of hawk, baqalyaa, -yihi.
haze: n., shuux, -i, shululuc; the sky is hazy, cirku wa shululucayaa.
head: n., madax, -i; head ache, madax xanuun, -ki; the head of the bed, sariirta madaxeeda; be the head, u madax ahaw.
heal: v.tr., bogsi, u bogsii or bogsii; be healed, bugsoo.
healthy: a., nin caafimaad qaba, ninki caafimaadka qabay.
heap: n., tul, -ki, rasays, -ki; v.tr., tul, rasay, moos.
hear: v.tr. and v.i., dhegayso, maqal, aqbal, ka aqbal; v.c., maqashii.
heart: n., wadno or wadne, -ihi, qalbi, -gi, calool, -shi.
heat: n., huur, -ki, kul, -ki; v.tr., (make warm) kululay.
heave: v.tr., (lift up) sare u haad, laal; v.., (pant) hinraag.
heir: n., nin daxal ah, ninki daxalka ahaa (the...).
hell: n., cadaab, -ti, naar, -ti; hellfire, dab cadaabeed, dab naareed.
help: n., caawin, -ti, caawimaad, -di, gargaar, -ki, hiil, -ki; v.tr., la caawi, caawin, gargaar, u hiili, la qabo; God help you, Eebbahay ha kaa caawino; it is a thing we cannot, waa waxaynan iska karayn; go for help, qaylo, qayla gee, caawinaad u kac.
hen: n., digaaga, -di, luki, -di, tujad or tijad, -ki.
hereafter: ad., aminka dabadeed, hadda ka dambow.
hero: n., nin diiran; be a hero, diiranaw.
hide: n., (skin) harag, -gi; hide of camels, meera, -ihi; hide of neat cattle, saan, -ti; hide of antelope, idin, -ti.
hide, v.tr., (conceal) dhuumi, qari, qarso; v.r., dhuumo, is qari.
hiding: n., dhuumasho, -adi, qaris, -ki; hiding place, meel qarsoon, meeshi qarsoonayd.
high: a., dheer; high water, baddi waa buuxdaa.
hill: n., buur yar, -ti, -ayd, karin, -ti, kur, -ti, kurun, -ti, moos, -ki; v.tr., (heap up) moos.
hind: n., (part of the arm) cudud, -di; hind leg, lug, -ti.
hinder: v.tr., u diid; you hinder me, waqtigaygi baa ii diidaysaa.
hiss: n., foori, -di; v.tr. and v.i., foori, u foori.
history: n., sheeko, -adi; tell a history, sheekee, sheeko u mari.
hit: hit, v.tr., ku dhufo; hit the mark, la dugo, la toogo.
hive: n., (cell of bees) dhahab, -ki; empty hive, dhahab madhan; full hive, dhahab buuxa.
ho!: hoa! int., war hoy! naa hoy!
hold: n., qabasho, -adi; hold of a ship, qaani, -gi; he let go his hold,ninku waa deynayaa; get hold, qabso; they could not take hold of his words, hadalkiisii xejin kari waayay.

hold, v.tr., (keep in the hand) hoo, xeji, qabo; hold him fast, aad u xeji; he held the dagger to his throat, isaga oo bilaawihi qoorta kaga haya; I hold him but a fool, anaa haya qof waalan baanse u aqaan; v.i., (stand, adhere) ku dheg; up, sarrai u tag; hold in false security, dag.
hole: n., booraan, -ti, dalool, -ki, god, -ki, hog, -gi, galsho, -adi.
holla: int., war! naa! war yaa! war hoy! naa hoy! war yaa hoy!
home: n., aqalka, guri, -gi; go home, aqalka qabo, hooyo.
honest: a., aamin, -ki, aamin ah; be honest, aamin ahaw.
honour: n., maamuus, -ki, -ti, murwad, -di; v.tr., maamuus, murwad, murway.
hoof: n., (of camels) gomod, -di; (of horses, asses, oxen ...) qoob, -ki; (of goats or sheep) qanjaful, raf, -ki.
hook: n., (wooden one) hangool, -ki; a fishing hook, jilib or jilaab, -ki.
hope: n., sugniin, -ti; my hope is in God alone, sugniintaydu Ilaahay keliyaa ku taal; v.tr., sug; I hope in God, Ilaahay baan sugayaa.
horizon: n., meesha cirka iyo dhulku iska hayaan or is kaga yaaliin or iska kala hayaan.
horror: n., naxdin, -ti; the horror of hell, naarta naxdinteeda.
horse: n., faras, -ki, fardo, -ihi; male horse, sanga or sange, -ihi; (stallion) koorma or koorme, -ihi, or faras qood qaba; herd of horses, fadhi farda ah; white horse, hay, -gi; red horse, ashkar, or ashkir, -ki; black horse, tukay, -ihi; chestnut horse, xamar, -ki; grey horse, maydal, -ki; whitish-grey horse, caynab, -ki; horseback, adax, -di; croup, fan, -ki; horse boy, sebiyaan, -ki; horse dealer, faras jir, -ki; horse shoe, nacal, -ki; horse tail, qanaan, -ti.
hot: a., kulul, kulayl, huur weyn; cause to be hot, huuri; feeling hot, huursan; hot sand, raran, -ki.
hour: n., saacad, -di; half an hour, saacad badhkeed; a quarter of an hour, saacad waaxdeed.
house: n., aqal, -ki; stone house, daar, -ti; wooden house, gembisa, -di; coffee house, maqaayad, -di; public house, dukaan, -ki; house front, aqal hortii.
how?: ad., sidee? how do you do? sidaad tahay? iska warran? how goes the world? dunida ka warran? he gave us an account how it was, siday ahayd yuu nooga warramay; you see how I love you, waad arkaysaa sidaan ku jeclahay; many fools there are in the world! imisaa wax waalan dunida jooga! or Eebbohow maxaa wax waalan dunida jooga! far halkay jirtay? intay fogtahay or jirtaa? how old is he? waa imisa jir? how far is it thither? halkaa ilaa halkoy imisay isu jiraan? how far it is thither! halkaasi fogaa! how long have you been here? imisaad halkan joogtay? how long will you abuse my patience? imisaan kuu dhaafi? how is that? waxaasi waa sidee? tell me how I may speak to him? ii sheeg si aan ula hadlo? God knows how to deliver us, Ilaahay baa og si aynu ku baxsanno or si uu inoogu sahlo.
however: ad., si kasta; however it be, si kastay ahaato or noqoto; however he be, mid un or mid kasta ha ahaado.
huddle: v.tr., (throw in confusion) qalad, isku qalad.
huff: v.i., (swell with anger) ciil u surun.
hull: n., (husk) qolof, -ti, jidhif or jilif, -ti, laf, -ti.
humbug: n., (sham) qalaalif, -ti; v.tr., qalaalif ka shub.
humour: n., (of the body) dheecaan, -ki; (of the nose) duuf, -ki, siin, ki; (temper) abuur, -ki, -ti.
hump: hunch, n., tuur, -ti; hump backed, tuur leh, ninki tuurta lahaa; hump of camels, kurus, -ki.
hunch: n., (a knock with the fist) tantoomo, tumujo, -adi; v.tr., (push) riix.
hunger: n., gaajo, -adi; hunger fit, gaaja xun, gaajadii xumayd, harqad, -di.
hungry: a., gaajaysan, ninkii gaajaysna; he is always humgry, had iyo goor waa gaajaysan yahay; be hungry, gaajo; I am hungry, waan gaajoonayaa or gaajaa i haysa; I feel a hungry fit, gaaja xun yaa i haysa.
hurry: n., hawl badan; the man is in a hurry, ninki hawsha badnaa; v.tr., degdeg u qabo; v.i., degdeg.
hurt: n., cawar, -ki, qoon, -ti, nabar, ki; v.tr., cawar, xanuuni, qoon yeel; v.r., qoon is yeel; a., cawaran; be hurt, cawaran or cawarnaw.
hut: n., bul, -ki; hut of one family, jees, -ki; hut of several families not agglomerated, jeesas, -ki.
hyæna: n.; striped hyæna, didar, -ki, xabaal fure, -ihi; spotted hyæna, candhadheer, -ki, -ti, dhurwaa, -gi, xoror, -ki, waraabe, -ihi, weera, -ihi.
idle: a., caajis, -ki, caajis ah, wahsan; be idle, caajisnaw, wahso.
ignorant: a., oqoon darran, oqoon la’, caruur, -ti, juhala, -ihi.
ill: a., (bad) xun; (sick) buka; be ill, xumaw; n., that boy returns ill (bad) for good, inankaasi sharkuu wanaag u ceshaa; he speaks ill of everyone, isagu nin walba wax xil leh buu ka sheegaa.
imitate: v.tr., (copy) mid u eg samee; (endeavour to resemble) isaga kale noqo.
immediately: ad., aminkada, iminkada, markiiba, haddada, haddadatan.
impenetrable: impenetrability of a forest, n., hawd, -ki.
implore: v.tr., bari; implore for us, nooga qaad.
importunity: n., (looking at someone when eating) qud, -ki.
impose: v.tr., saar; impose a fine, casir; impose taxes, cashuur saar.
impossible: a., lama kar, lama karo; it is impossible, wax lama kar ah.
impostor: n., beenaale, or beenawaas, -ki, nin muqalqal ah.
impurity: n., makhnuudnimo, -adi, wasmo, -adi; commit impurity, was.
incantation: n., faal, -ki; make an incantation, faal.
incantator: n., nin wax fala, naag wax fasha.
incapable: n., (of fighting) hashin, -ti, nin hashin ah.
inclination: n., fooror, -ki, cuskis, -ki; profound inclination, rako, -di, sujuud, -di.
incline: v.fr., foorori, cuski; incline on, ku tiiri.
incline: v.i., foororso, cusko, tiirso; incline on, upon, ku tiirso, rakaco; inclined to evil, nin waliba wax xun buu ujeedaa.
increase: v.tr., badi, badnee, kordhi; v.i., badnaw.
infallible: a.. ma beenayn karo, been ma sheegi karo, ma khatalmi karo.
inform: v.tr., war gee, war keen, warran, ogaysii; v.r., iska warran.
injurious: a., wax yeela leh, (eray) aan la is odhan.
innocent: a., xujad la’, tacsiir la’, aan tacsiir lahayn.
inoffensive: a., (waa bunduq) aan cidna wax yeelin.
inscribe: v.tr., ku qor, waraaqda ku dhig.
intelligent: a., carrab jilicsan, miyirsan, miyir qaba.
intend: v.tr., damac; what do you intend to do, maxaad damacsantahay.
intercede: v.i., dhex gal, u gacan geli.
interjection (of inticing): car! car! (of pain) ha! (of calling) war hoy! naa hoy! (for parents) ayaa aabbe! ayaa hooyo!
interpret: v.tr., ka afceli, u kala afceli.
interpretation: n.; that interpretation is not good, kala afceliskaasi ma toosna.
intervert: v.tr., geesta kale u dhig or u rog.
intestine: n., uuslahays, -ti, uuslaho or uusloho, -adi; long intestine, xiidmo, -ihi, mindhicir, -ki.
intimate: n., (a familiar friend) saaxib run ah or saaxib dhab ah.
intrepid: a., cabsi la’, bilileh, geesi, -gi, rag ah.
introduce: v.tr., geli, ku kaxay, abuur, sinif.
inutile: a., aan waxba tarayn, wax ma tare.
invisible: a., lama arko, aan la arki karin; God is invisible, Ilaah waa wax aan la arki karin.
iron: n., bir, -ti, sulub, -ki; iron wire, hasaw, -di; v.tr., (smooth the clothes with iron) birta mari.
irregular: a., janjeedh ah; make irregular, janjeedhi.
Islam: Islamism, n., nin Islaameed, diinti Islaameed.
itch: itching, n., caadho, -adi, cadhanyo, -adi; v., cadhanyo.
ivory: n., fool maroodi, foolki maroodi, the ivory.
jackal: n., dawaca dulmadow ah, golli, -di, golli waraabays, -ki, xoor, -ki.
jar: n., (vessel) dhiil, -shi, gog, -gi, haan, -ti, qumbo, -adi, mardaban, -ki.
jealous: a., xaasid, -ki; be jealous, xasid, gubo.
jeer: n., (scoff) luquf, -ki; v.tr. and v., luqufi or luqfi, ku qosol; maxaad ii luqufinaysaa? why are you (laughing or) jeering at me?
join: v.tr., isku dar, isu gee, isku xidh, isku qodob, isku samee, isku tol.
joint: n., xubin, -ti, fanax, -hi; he has put his arm out of joint, gacantiisii waa fudhuxday.
journey: n., kabaday, -ihi, sodcaal, -ki; half day's journey, daldala, -sho, -adi; camel day's journey, geedi, -gi; v.i., kabaday, sodcaal.
joy: joyfulness, n., badhaadh, -ki, rayn, -ti, faraxan, -ki, farxad, -di, raaxo, -adi.
joyful: joyous, a., badhaadhan, badhaadhsan, raaxaysan, faraxaan ah, faraxsan.
joyousness: jubilation, n., badhaadh, -ki...; give joy, kaga badhaadhi or badhbadhaadhi.
judge: n., dawlad, -di, nin dawladeed, xaakin, -ki; v.tr., xisaab xukum, gar goy.
just: a., hagaagsan, xaq, taagan, quman, rag ah, tolmoon.
jowari: or jowaree, n., (kind of corn) hadhuudh or haruudh, -ki; jowari plant, kasab, qasab, -ki, salool, -ki.
kahri: or curry, n., sanuunad, -di; curry stuff, xawaaj, -ki; make the curry, sanuunadda samee; mix curry with rice, sanuunadee.
keep: v.tr., hoo, hay, hayso, qabo; keep for you, dhigo, qaado; keep your promise, hadalkaaga daso or xejiso; keep asunder, kala baydhi; keep away, off, fogay, fogee, ka fogee; keep back, dib u celi; keep down, hoos u hay; keep under your temper, camalkaaga iska hoosaysii; keep where you are, halkaad joogtid joog; keep off, duw, naga duw.
kettle: n., digsi or disti, -gi, dheri, -gi, adar, -ki.
kick: n.; kick of man, laad, -ki; kick in a kind of game, hurdun, -ki; kick of a horse, ass, mule…, biqlay or biqlo, -ihi, dambaabudh or dambabidh, -ki; kick of a camel, haraati, -di; v.tr., laad, hurdan.
kill: v.tr., dil, nafta ka qaad, kaga caqbal, ka kawsii, ka kudi.
kind: a., (good) wanaagsan, tolmoon; n., (sort) cayn, -ki, tol, -ki; of the same kind, isku tol.
kindred: n., (kin) xidid, -ki; become kindred, la xidid.
knave: n., xaaraami, -gi, tuug, -gi, nin xaaraami ah.
knee: n., jilib, -ki, rug, -gi; knee-pan, kurankur, -ti; bend the knee, jilibka dhig.
kneel: v., jilba joogso; remain kneeling, jilba joog, jilba yara dhig; kneel and make the profound inclination, sujuud; kneel (in speaking to the camel), arun, tu; make the camel kneel, arumi, tu.
knock: n., (at the door) garaac, -i, knock with a club, gagab, -i, kaw, -di; v.tr., garaac; knock down, budhay, ka dufo, gagabi, ka kawsii.
knot: n., guntin, -ti, gunti, -gi, gar, -ki; v.tr., gunud, garay, garayso.
know: v.tr., garo, ogow, oqoon, og; I do not know, mooji; v.c., ogaysii.
known: a., la yaqaan; well known, macruuf, -ki; a well known man, nin macruuf ah.
koodoo: n., (antelope in general) adeeryo, -adi; lesser koodoo, adeeryo ari, -gi; male koodoo, goodir, -ki.
labour: n., hawl, -shi, shuqul, -ki; v.tr., shaqee, hawl qabo, hawshoo, xooji.
lac: n., (100,000 rupees, in India) laak, boqol kun oo rubood, laak rubiyadood.
ladle: (or a vessel with a handle), n., dhuraa, qudda, -ihi, tebeda dara, -ihi.
lamb: n., baraar, -ki; she lamb, nayl, -shi; he lamb, wan baraar ah.
lame: (of one leg), n., dhutiyay, -yihi; lame woman, dhutiso, -adi; go lame, dhuti.
lament: n., baroor, -ti, muusanow, -gi, oyn, -ti; v.i., barooro, oy, muusanow; v.c., ka baroori.
land: land, v.i., (put ashore) deg; v.tr., deji, rog, soo rog, alaabaddaada rog.
large: a., ballaadhan, weyn; large footed, kabo weyn.
largeness: n., ballaadh, -ki, weynaan, -ti; largeness of feet or sandals, kabo weynaan.
larva: n., dirxi, -gi; larva of gnats, lunlumay, -ihi.
last: a., (utmost) ugu dambeeyay, ugu dambeesay; at last, aakhirtaanka.
late: a., raagsan; (deceased) dhintay (m.), dhimatay (f); be late, raag; was it so late? ma sidaasay u raageen? he came late, waa soo raagay.
laugh: laugh, v., qosol; laugh at, ku qosol.
launch: v.tr., (to force a ship into the sea) kawir.
lavish: a., (prodigal) lumay, nin lumay; v.tr., lumi.
lawful: a., xalaal; make him lawful, xalaalay.
lay: v.tr., (place) dhig; lay aside, dhaq, dhaqo, dhigo; lay away, reeb; lay before, open out, muuji, tus; lay over, dusha ka saar; lay on, ku reeb; lay down, u dhiibo; lay hold of, hoo.
lazy: a., caajis, -ki, caajis ah, wahsan; be lazy, caajisnow, wahso.
lead: lead, v.tr., (guide) badbaadi, kaxay; lead from, out of, ka badbaadi; lead to, u kaxay; lead the dance, cayaarta hagaaji; lead the prayer, ina tuki or tuji.
leaf: n., caleen, -ti; leaf of a palm-tree, caw, -di.
leak: n., dalool, -ki; v.i., dalool; the kettle leaks, distigii waa daloolaa.
lean: lean (animal), n., abax, -i; a., abax ah; be lean, abax; v.c., abaxi.
lean, a., caataysan, weydsan; be lean, caatow, weydow; v.c., weydee.
lean, v.tr., (incline) tiiri, cuski; v.i., tiirso, cusko; lean upon, ku tiiri, ku tiirso.
least: a., ka wada yar, ugu yar.
leave: leave, v.tr., (let go) daa, nac; leave aside, meel dhigo; leave out, ka qadhi; leave behind, dambaysii; leave on, ku reeb; v.i., iska daa, iska reeb.
left: (hand), n., bidix, -di; to the left, bidixda; left handed, guray, -gi.
leg: hind-leg, n., lug, -ti; fore-leg, jeeni, -gi; leg below the knee, kub, -ki, shansho, -adi; leg of a chair, rukun, -ki.
one-legged man, n., nin lug la’, luglaawe, -ihi.
lengthen: v.tr., dheree, dheeray, dhereri; lengthen by adding to, isku dhereri.
let: v.i., daa; let me alone, idaa; let me go out, dibadda ii siidaa; why do you let him come in? maxaad gudaha ugu soo daynaysaa? let the boys sleep, caruurta daa ha seexatee; let down, hoosaysii; let in, into, soo geli, soo daa; let go, sii daa, soo daa; let me see, bal aan arko; let him speak, ha hadlo; let it be so, ha ahaato, sidaa ha ahaato, I have let a house, aqal baan kiraystay.
level ground: n., ban, -ki, gegi, -di, tamux, -di, meel tamux ah.
lid: n., dabool, -ki, hadhuub, -ki, hadhuub gal, -ki, gorof, -ki, dabaq, -i.
lie: lie: v.i., (tell a lie) been sheeg.
lie, v., (rest) jiif, jiifso, ool; he lies along upon the ground, dhulkuu yaal, dhulkuu yiil.
life: n., noolaan, -ti, rubad, -ki, naf, -ti; lifetime, cimri, -gi; next life, noolaanta aakhiro or noolaanta dambe.
lift: v.tr., hinji, kor or sare u qaad.
light: n., if, -ki, iftiin, -ki, ilays, -ki; light of the day, gabal, -ki; v.tr., iftiimi, siraad shid, ololi.
lighten: v.tr., iftiimi; it lightens, cirku waa hilaacayaa.
like: a., (resembling) le’eg, intaas oo kale, intaas le’eg; like father like son, aabbaha inankuna u eg yahay; make like, u ekaysii; in like manner, sidii oo kale.
like, v.tr., (love) jeclaw; do you like his advice? taladiisa ma jeceshahay? do you like it? ma jecashahay or jeceshahay?
likely: ad., (probably) malaha; he is likely to die of hunger, malaha gaajaa dili doonta; we are likely to have war, dagaal baynu u dhownahay.
liking: n., (inclination); having the same liking, isku talo.
lime: n., dareyo, -adi, malaas, -ti; quick, dhagax gubtay.
line: n., diilin, -ti, sadar, -ki, tax, tixi; the line, lines of the hand, herro or herriyo, -adi; range in, tax, isku tax.
lion: n., libaax, -i; male lion, aar, -ki, female lion, gool, -shi.
listen: v.i., dhegayso, maqal, yeel; listen to, aqbal, ka aqbal.
little: a., yar, gaban ah, gibin ah, gaban; ad., wax xoogaa or waa xoogaa or waxoogaa, yar, qun-yar.
litany: n., qunuud, -di; recite the litany, qunuudda mari.
live: v.., (be alive) noolaw, jir; (dwell) fadhi, jir, joog, ool, rugayso.
liver: n., beer, -ti; liver of camels, waslado, -ihi.
living: a., (alive) nool; living property, xoolo nool, -ihi, -aa.
lizard: n., qorato, -adi, geelkacabaadis, roor, -ki, maso or monso, -adi.
load: v.tr., rar, shexnad, cabee; n., xamil, -ki, rar, -ki, rarmo, -adi.
loaded: laden, a., raran, cabaysan, shexnadan, buuxa.
loathe: v.tr., (abhor) nac; he loathes every meat, hilib walba waa ka yiqyiqsanayaa; v.i., (create disgust) yiqyiqsi.
lobe: n., (of the ear) dacal, -shi, dhegta dacasheeda; upper part of lobe, qurdan or qurjan, -ki.
loin: n., (reins) kelli, -di; cloth, macawis, -ki, go’, -i, hayd, -ki.
long: a., dheer; long in prayer, duca ku raag, -gi; long disease, cudur raagay; you are very long in coming, waad raagtaa; long after, ad., goor dambow; how long is it since? imisaa ka dambeeyay or dambaysay?

long, ad., long ago, beri hore; not long before, ayaamo dhoweyd; ere long, goor dhowba; I will come ere long, goor dhowba waa imaan doonaa; as long as I live, inta aan noolahay; as long as he is virtuous he will be admired, intaas uu wanaagsan yahay waa lala yaabi; all my life long, intaan jiray oo dhan, or intaan noolaa oo dhan, or intaan noolaa oo idil; all day long, maalin oo idil.

long, v.tr., (desire earnestly) ka raag; I long to see him, araggaagi baan ka raagsanahay, or inaan arko waan doonayaa; long for, tabaalaysnaw; he longs for this place, meeshatanuu u tabaalaysanyahay.
look: look, v.i.; he looks very well, waa caafimaad qabaa; that looks well, waa wanaagsan yahay or wanaagsan tahay; look about you, is eeg, is jir; look after, to the boy, inanka eeg or ilaali or jir; look at, day, bal eeg; look out, look for, doon, baadh; what do you look for? maxaad doonaysaa, or maxaad raadinaysaa? I have long looked for him, in badan baan sugayay; look into, look over, hubso; look there, look at, u jeed, u jeeso, xagga u jeeso; let me look at the ship they speak of, bal aan eego markabka la sheegayo; look at a man eating, quud; looking at a man when eating, n., quud, -ki.
look, v.tr., arag, eeg, day, jeedaali, dhugo.
lose: v.tr., xoor, ambi, habaabi, hallee, lumi, beel; v.i., calaacal, ambo, habaab, hallaw, lun.
loss: n., hallaw, -gi; suffer a loss, eed; suffering of a loss, eedis, -ki; loss of a person, habaab, -ki.
lounge: v.i., (to idle) ku tiirso; do not lounge, haku tiirsan.
love: n. jacayl, -ki, jeclaan, -ti; v.tr., jeclaw; do not love, ha jeclaan.
low: a., hoose; be low, hoosay; ad., hoos, hoosta; speak low, hoos u hadal.
lower: v.tr., (bring low) hoos u qabo, hoos u hay.
luck: n., ayaan, -ki, nasiib, -ki; good luck, cawo, -adi; bad luck, ayaan xumo; wish him good luck, qalib.
lump: n., (a mass) fud, -ki, kuus, -ki; a lump of sugar, fud sonkor ah.
madden: v.tr. and v., waal, is waalwaal.
magician: n., nin wax fala, naag wax fasha.
maim: v.tr., addin go’; a., addin la’.
make: v.tr., samee, waxee; make well, aad u qabo or samay; make again, ku laaban.
made: a., la waxay, samaysan; made of, ka samaysmay; be made, samaysan, samaysnaw.
male: n., labood, -ki, qododi; a., lab, qod ah.
malevolent: malignant, a., khabiidi, -gi, khabiidi ah, khabiidiga ah.
man: n., nin, -ki, rag, -gi; he is grown a man, waa gadh madowbay; man of prudence, wisdom, fariid, -ki, nin fariid ah; man of war, markab xarbi ah.
manage: v.tr., tali, ku tali; manage that office, xafiiskaa u tali.
mane: n., (of a horse) guud, -ki; hair of the mane, sayn, -ti.
manner: n., si, -di, basar, -ki; in this manner, sidaan; do in the same manner, sidii loo sameeyay u samee, in what manner? sidee? (custom) dastuur, -ti; having the same manners, isku talo.
map: n., warqadda dunidu ku sawiran tahay.
march: v.., soco, talaab, baydh; v.c., socodsii, talaabi; n., socod, -ki, talaabo, -adi.
mark: n., calan, -ki, astaan, -ti, sumad, -di, qanjidh, -di; v.tr., calaamadi, sumad.
married: a., guursaday; a married man, nin guursaday; a married woman, naag la guursaday, naag nin leh; a new married man, aroos, -ki.
marry: v.tr., u guuri, u dhis, isu guuri, meheri; marry your daughter to me, gabadhaada ii meheri; v.i., guurso; v.r., meherso; marry your sister-in-law in a second marriage, dumaal.
marvellous: a., yaaban, yaab leh, la yaabsan.
master: n., saaxeb, -ki, maqadin, -ki; school-master, mucalim, -ki, fiqi, -gi, bare, -ihi.
master, v.tr., u tali; (subdue) jara bar, layli, dastuur xun karaw.
matter: n., (pus) dheecaan, -ki, malax, di; (cause) sabab, -ti, eed, di; what is the matter? eeddu waa maxay? or maxaad leedahay? I make no matter of it, yeelkiisa!
maturity: n., bisayl, -ki; age of maturity, gan, -ki; the man at the age of maturity, gadh madowbay.
may: aux.v., kar; you may if you wish, hadaad rabtid waa kartaa; if it may be, haday jiri karto; if I may say so, hadaan sidaa odhan karayo; as much as may be, intaad kartid.
meal: n., cunno, -adi, hadhimo, -adi, suxuur, -ti, afur, -ki; take your meal, suxuuro.
meaning: n., macno, -ihi; what is the meaning of this word? eraygaa macnihiisu waa maxay?
means: n.; by all maens, kolley; by no means, sinna.
measure: n., geedka lugu qiyaaso, maylin, -ki; take the measure, qiyaas; v.tr., dhudhumi, diraac.
meat: n., hilib, -ki, jimid, -ki, cad, -ki, muqmad, -di, kumbis, -ki, jidh, -ki; fat of meat, baruur, -ti.
medicine: n., dawo, -adi, sanaxo, -adi; give medicine, daway.
meet: v.tr., la kulan; v.i., is urura.
meeting: n., kulan, -ki, shir, -ki, urur, -ki; have a meeting, shira, soo shira.
melancholic: a., qulubsan; be melancholic, wahan, qulub.
melon: n., batiikh, -hi; watermelon, xabxab, -ki; wild melon, unun, -ki.
melt: v.tr., dhalaali, dhaqaaji; melt in, ku dhalaali.
mention: v.tr., sheeg; do not mention, haba sheegin.
merciful: a., naxariis leh, raxiim, -ki, nin raxiim ah.
mercy: n., naxdin, -ti, naxariis, -ti, raxmad, -di; have mercy, nax, naxariiso.
mesh: n., god, hog; there was plenty of fish in the meshes of the net, godadka shabagga kaluun badan baa ku jiray.
Messiah: n., Masiix, Kiristos, Ciisa al Masiix.
middle: midst, n., dhex, -di; go in the middle, u dhexee.
might: n., xoog, -gi, itaal, -ki; aux.v., kari lahaa.
milk: n., caano, -ihi; fresh milk, dhay, -di; milk of ewe, caana idaad; milk of goat, caana riyaad; fresh camel's milk, qor, -ki; sour milk, caano dhanaan; sour milk of camels, karuur, -ti; turned milk, baq; the milk has turned, caanahaa baqay; curdle milk, gadhoodh, -ki; butter milk, ciir, -ti; milk and water mixed, badhax, -i; milk and butter mixed, buqbuqood, -ki, weeldo, -adi.
milk, v.tr., lis, soo lis, maal, soo maal, maqaar ku maal, dharar maal.
mind: mind, v.tr., hubso, fooyigow; mind well what I say, waxaan ku leeyahay aad u hubso; mind your business, dantaada fooyigow; mind your health, caafimaadkaa dhawr; I shall mind the boy, wiilkaan jiri; v.r., iska dhawr, iska eeg, iska jir, nin foojigan ahaw; v.tr., (put in mind) xusuusi.
miscarry: v.i., ilma iska qoon; v.c., ilma ka qoon.
mischief: n., xisdi, -gi, waxyeello, -adi; do some mischief, waxyeel.
miser: n., bakhayl, -ki, bakhaylad, -di, dhabxal, -ki, masuug, -gi, mudal, -ki.
mislead: v.tr., khataal, qalqaal; be misled, khataalan.
mistake: n., khatalad, -di, ilowsho, -ihi; be mistaken, khataalan.
mock: v.tr., luqufi or luqfi, ku qosol.
modest: a., xil or xishood badan; be modest, xishoo.
money: n., lacag, -ti; money box, case, or linen money bag, kiish, -ki; leathern purse, kiishad, -di.
monsoon: (N.E.), n., bad furan, -ki; (S. W.) bad xidhan, -ki.
monthly: ad., bil walba; I go to Aden monthly, bishiiba mar baan Cadan tagaa.
moon: n., dayax, -i; moon light, caddo, -adi; half moon, dayax badhkii; full moon, dayax dhan, dayixi dhamaa; new moon, dayax cusub; quarter of the moon, bil, -shi.
more: a., ka badan, ka roon; will you have more? ma ka badsanaysaa? ad., once more, mar kale; no more, never more, in, inta ka dambaysa.
morning: n., aroor, -ti, subax, -i; this morning, saaka; early morning, arooryo, -adi.
morrow: n., berri, -di; tomorrow, ad., berri, berrito; until tomorrow, halkiyo berri.
mortar: n., (to grind in) malkad, -ki; mortar of wood, mooya or mooye, -ihi; (lime and sand mixed) nuurad, -di.
most: a., ka wada badan, ugu badan.
mouse: n., jiir yar, -ki, -a; a small mouse, bara duub leh.
mouthful: n., cantuugo, -adi, luqmad, -di; give a mouthful, cantuuji.
move: v.tr. and v.i., dhaqdhaqaaq, bayd, duw, durug, soco, lul, walaaq; move from, off, ka baydh, ka durug, ka duw, ka soco.
much: a., badan; as much, so much, intaa, intaas, intaa oo kale.
muddy: a., dhoobo badan, saboh; muddy place, diidi, -gi.
mule: n., baqlad, -di; he mule, baqlad lab.
murmur: mumble, v.i., gunuus, hoos u guux; n., gunuus, -ki.
muzzle: n., gafuur, -ki, afuuf, -ti; v.tr., afuuf; (only tying) ganaf.
myope: a., arag daran, imamowsan; be myope, imamowsan.
myrrh: n., malmal, -ki; myrrh tree, *didin, -ki; false myrrh tree, xabaghadi, -gi.
mystery: n., wax aan la garan, wax aan la karin.
nail: n., (of the finger) ciddi, -di; iron nail, mismaar or musmaar, -ki.
name: n., magac, -i; v.tr., u bixi, ugu yeedh.
narrate: v.tr., sheeko u mari, u sheekee.
near: al. and prp., ag, agta, dhow, sokay, xigta; be near, dhowow, xig; come near, soo dhowow, soo durug; go near, u dhowow, u durug; put near, soo dhoway, u dhoway, isku dhoway.
nephew: n., inanki or ina walaalkay, walaalkay baa dhalay, walaashay baa dhashay.
never: ad., abadan, abkay, abidkayna, weligay; never mind, yeelkiisa, yeelkeeda.
news: n., war, -ki; good news, nabad, -di; bring news, war gee or keen; bring news from, ka war keen; a man receiving news, warqab, -ki.
next: a., dhow, soke, xiga; the next house, aqalka soke or dhow or xiga; the next month, bisha dambe; the next day, berri; tell me the next word, erayga ka shisheeya ii sheeg; I will do better next time, mar dambe waan ka wanaagi; be next to, xig.
nice: a., baxsan, aad, door, shuban, wanaagsan.
nicely: (make), v.tr., qorxi, qorox u yeel, wanaaji, hagaaji.
niece: n., (my) gabadhi or inanti walaalkay or walaashay.
night: n., habeen, -ki; (time of sleeping) saq, -di; midnight, saq dhexe; tonight, caawa; last night, xalay; go at night, gud.
noise: n., sanqadh, -di, qab or qabqab, -ti, qaad, wac, -di, haw, -di, baf! fof, -ki; make a noise, kaga sanqadhi.
nomad: ad. and n., reer guuraa, -gi; Somals are a nomad people, dadka Soomaaliyeed waa dad aan meelna ku hadhin.
noon: n., duhur, -ki, hadh, -di; afternoon, duhurka dabadiisa.
nose: n., san, -ki; flat nose, san ballaadhan; wipe your nose, siinso, iska tir, iska siimi.
not: ad., aan, ma; there is not, ma jiro; is it not?, soo ma aha?
now: ad., aminka, iminka, hadday, haddeer; now-a-days, haatan; just now, iminkada, haddadatan.
number: n., (mark) sumad, -ki; (sum) tiro, -adi; a certain number, dhawr, -ki.
obey: v.tr., (be obedient) dhega nuglow, dhegayso, yeel.
oblique: a., qalloocan, ma toosna, ma shubna.
occur: v.., noqo; it occurs, waxay noqotay.
offering: n., sadaqad, sadaqad Eebbahay loo gubay.
often: ad., goor, kol, mar badan, dhawr goor, qajayla, yaala.
old: a., gabow, duq ah, duug ah; old man, oday, -gi, islaan, -ki, wadaad, -ki, waayeel, -ki; old woman, habar, -ti, islaan, -ti, wadaadad, -di; old age, da’ weyn, gabow, gi; old people, dad gaboobay, nin da’ weyn, duq, -di; old thing, duug; grow, be old, v.i., gabow; old times, beryihii hore.
omit: v.tr., iska daa, ka hadhi; be omitted, ka hadh.
once: a., (one time) mar; (formerly) beri, -gi, waa, -gi, beri hore, waa hore, kolki hore, kolkii; it was once, beri or waa waxaa jiray.
one: num., kow, -di, mid, -ki, -di; one by one, mid mid; less one, mid la’; it is all one, gidi waa isku wada mid; it is all one to me, gidi wa isugu kay mid; it is all one as if you threw your money into the river, gidi waa mid sidaad lacagtaadi durdurka ku riday; everyone, mid walba; they eat one another, waa is cunaan; one-handed, gacan keli ah leh.
order: n., (command) xukum, -ki; (regular disposition) hagaajis, -ki; v.tr., (command) u dir; (regulate) hagaaji, wanaaji, hagaajiso, wanaajiso.
ostrich: n., gorayo, -adi; male ostrich, goray, -gi, haldhaa, -gi.
other: a., kale; the other, kii kale, kan kale; another, mid kale.
outside: ad., dibadda; n. and ad., duleed, -ki; he is outside, isagu duleedkuu jooga.
over: prp., dul, dusha, gud, gudka, kor; over again, weliba; be over, ka sarray.
owe: v.tr.; I owe you money, lacag baad igu leedahay.
owl: n., shimbir libaax, -di; small owl, ciyow, -di.
pail: n., baaldi, -gi; pail of skin, dandul, -shi, dowlis, -ki, gorof, -ki, wadaan, -ti.
pain: pain, v.tr., (afflict) xanuuni, xanuuji, silci; v.imp., xanuun.
palm: n., (of the hand) baabaco, -adi, calaacal or calaancal, -shi, saab, -ki.
parallel: a., siman; they are parallel, bay isu wada jiraan.
pardon: n., saamax, -di, cafi, -gi; v.tr., saamax, cafi; pardon each other, is cafiya.
part: n., in, -ti, qayb, -ti; (half) go’, -i; (party), take his part, la meel noqo.
part, v.tr., (partake) qayb, kala go’; part with, kala goosta.
part, v.i., (quit) tag, ka tag; we must part, aan tagno, aan kala tagno.
partial: v.i., (be) ka eexo; partial sentence, gar eexo, -ti, eexada ahayd.
pass: v.i., dhaaf, mar; he passed by our door, albaabkayaguu maray; pass away, dhaaf; pass along the shore, xeebta sii mar; v.tr., pass the river, durdurka ka talaab; we shall pass the winter in the town, guga aan magaalada ku hadhno; pass near, ag mar, isku du; pass by the side, gees ka mar; pass across, dhex mar.
patience: n., dulqaadasho, -adi, kaadsi, -gi, sabir or samir, -ki, sugniin, -ti; have patience, or be patient, dhawr, sug, samir, dulqaado, kaadso.
patient: a., dulqaadasho badan, kaadsi leh, sugniin leh.
pay: v.tr., bixi; n., (payment) dheef, -ti, haqay, -gi, mushaharo, -adi.
peace: n., nabad, -di; heshiis, -ki, barax, -i; be in peace, nabad gal, nabad qab, nabad geliyo; they are living in peace, barax baa loo yaal; make peace, v.i., heshii, la heshii; make peace between them, v.tr., nabad qaado, heshiisii, nabdii.
peel: n., (rind) diir, -ki; v.tr., diil, diir; the act of peeling, diirin, -ki.
peg: v.tr., (fasten with a peg) dhidib; n., dhidib, -ki.
penance: n., toobad or tawbad, -di; make penance, toobad keen, toobad yeelo.
penetrate: v.i., gal; penetrate into, wareen, geli.
perfect: a., dhan; the perfect work, shuqulkii dhamaa.
perform: v.tr., fal; he performs his duties, dantiisa aad buu uqabtaa.
perfume: n., udgoon, -ki; act of perfuming, uunsi, -gi; perfume of incense, uumis, -ki; v.tr., udgoonay, uumi; v.r., is udgoonay, uunso; be perfumed, udgoonow; it is perfumed, la udgoonay.
perish: v.i., bakhti; I perish with hunger, gaajaan la bakhtiyaa.
permute: v.tr., is dhaafi, la is dhaafi.
persist: v.i., adkaw, si adag u wad.
person: n., qof, -ki, cid, -di, qudh, -i; a nice and good person, qulyad, -di.
perspiration: n., dhidid, -ki; being in perspiration, huursan, dhididsan.
phthisic: phthysis, n., qaaxo, -adi, laxaw, phthisic of cattle, sambab, -ki.
phthisic, phthisical, a., nin laxaw qaba.
physic: n., (medicine) daawo, dawo, -adi, daymo, -adi; practice physic, daawee, dawee.
pick: pick up, v.tr., gur; pick for, u gur; pick for yourself, guro, gurguro.
piece: n., in, -ti, xubin, -ti; little piece, in yar; piece of cloth, karrin, -ti; piece of meat, cad, -ki.
pierce: v.tr., dalooli, ku marooji, ku jooji, wareen.
pilgrimage: n., xaj, -ki; make a pilgrimage, xaaji, soo xaji.
pillow: n., barkimo, -adi; a wooden pillow, barki, -gi.
pine: v.i., (languish) weydow; v.tr., weyday; v.r., is weyday.
pipe: (of wood, used for blowing), n., gobays, -ki.
piss: v.i., (urinate) kaadi, so kaadi; n., kaadi, -di.
pit: n., gun, -ti, ceel, -ki, goof, -ki, god, -ki; pit of the stomach, labxo, -adi; pit of the knee, xagal, -shi; pit of the arm, kilkilo, -adi.
pity: n., naxdin, -ti, naxariis, -ti; have pity, naxariiso.

six: num., lex, -di; six fold, lex jeer oo min lex ah, or lex jeer oo lex wada ah.
skilful: a., fiican, farsamo badan, wax qaban og.
skin: n., duub, -ki, harag, -gi, saan, -ti; skin sewn to carry children, dhereb, -ti, furaad, -ki; skin sewn to make a couch, weelaalis, -ti; skin placed for a shed, gibil, -shi.
skin, v.tr., (flay) duubka or haragga or saanta ka bixi or ka mudhxi.
skull: n, indolay, -ihi; upper part of the skull, dhako, -adi, kug, ti; each side of the skull, gees, -ti.

slit: v.tr., jeexjeex, dildilaaci; v.i., dilaac, dildilaac; a., dilaacsan, jeexan; n., (a narrow opening) dilaac, -i, jeeb, -i.
slouch: n., (a clumsy boy) hogasho, -adi; v.i., (have a downcast look) hogo.
slough: n., (a deep, miry place) limad, -ki; (of a snake) qub, -ki.
slowly: ad., aayar or aadyar, qunyar; walking, dhukis.

sold: a., iibsan; be sold, ibsanaw; not sold, ma iibsana.

some: a., in, -ta, wax, wax xoogaa, har, -ki; somebody, nin un; -how, si un; something, wax un; sometimes, kolkol, marmar; somewhere, meel un.

soon: -ad, goor dhow; it is too soon, waad soo dhaqsatay.

stab: n., (of a sword) fajaso, -adi; stab with the flat of a sword, ballaadh, -ki; v.tr., fajas.
staff: n., ul, -shi, qori, -gi; staff of a spear, samay, -di; staff of an arrow, gamuun, -ki, leeb, -ki; bended staves used for making a Somali hut, dhig, -ti, dhig dooxo, -adi, dhig lool ah, -ihi, kabal, -ki, kaballo, -adi, lool, -ki, law, -ti.
stain: n., dhibic, -di, bar, -ti; v.tr., (maculate) see corrupt.
stammerer: n., nin haghag leh, nin labla'.
stanch: (stop) v.tr., jooji; stanch the blood, dhiigga joojí.
stand: n., joog, -gi, nasad, -ki; make a stand, joog, naso.

stand, v.i., taagnow, hagaag, hagaag u joogso; stand still, ha dhaqdhaqaaqin; my watch stands still, saacaddaydi waa joogsanaysaa; the bargain stands, baayacaaddi waa joogta or weliba taagan tahay; this house stands very well, aqalka meel wanaagsan buu ka dhisan yahay; a great many people stand about him, dad badan baa ku meersan, or dad badani waa ku meersan yahay; stand against, iska xeji, is karaw; God will stand by us, Eebbeheena waa ina ka reebi; I stood by when Ali killed the man, anigu waa soo joogay kolki Cali ninka dilay; for that office, anigu xafiiskaasan u jooga; God stands for us, Eebbeheen innagu ina la jira; that letter stands for..., xarafkaasi buu u jiraa; I need of a camel, aur baan u dan leeyahay; you stand in my light, iftiinkaygi baad iga fadhidaa; stand off, dib u joogso; stand out (resist), qaabil, u adkayso; stand out of the way, dawga ka baydh; stand out of my sight, araggayga ka libidh; stand to your word, hadalkaaga xejiso; stand up, taagnaw; stand with, la heshii.
standing: a., taagan; n., standing up (during Mahomedan prayers), faral, -ki.

still: a., aamusan; ad., ilaa iminka; still more, weliba.

stink: n., (bad smell) qudhmuun, -ki, ur qudhmuun; v.i., qudhmuun ahaw.

tack: v.tr., qodob, isku qodob, isku tol.
tail: n., dabo, -adi; tail of goats, dib, -ki; tail of sheep, dhilif, -ki; fat of the sheep, badhi, -dhi; lifting up the tail, qanaan, -ti.
take: v.tr., hoo, hay, hayso, qab, qabo, qaad, qaado, qabso; I took the cup at his hand, fujaanki gacantiisaan ka qaaday; take that malefactor, laayaanka qabso; they took the town, magaaladi qaatay; if I can take him, hadaan qaadan karo; take the meat out of the pot, cadka kasoo bixi distiga; take that physic, daawada qaado; it has taken root, xididay leedahay; take hold of that, waxaas qabso or xajiso; take a snuff, nashug urso; we took the longest way, dawgi ugu dheeraa baannu qabsannay or raacnay; take the shortest way, dawga ugu gaaban qabso; take care, heed, is garaw, foojigow, iska eeg, iska dhawr; take you no care of that, dan adigu ha u gelin; let your friends take part with you, u daa saaxiibyadaadu hakula wadaageenay; he took alarm at the noise, sanqadhii buu ku naxay; take a good resolution, tala aada qaado; I take you at your word, hadalkaagaan kuu daynayaa; take that word in good part, hadalkaa ha qoonsan; take him in a lie, been ku qabo; take in a bad deed, falniin xun ku qabo; take pity on him, u naxariiso; I took a great affection to him, jacayl wanaagsan baan u qabay; I shall take it as a great favour, sidii sado wanaagsan baan kaga aqbali; I will take that affair at my own peril, hawshaas sababtaydu ku qaadan doonaa; what course shall I take now? dawma aan qabsanayaa?; I take it to be the best way, sidii ugu wanaagsanayd baan u wadaa or u sidaa; he took offence at that, waxaasi cay u qaatay; take an account of the suit, arrintii war nooga keen; take my word for it, hadalkayga rumayso; take time, waqti qaado, dulqaado; take and keep, hoo oo qaado; take again, mar kale qaado; take back again, cesho; take him along with you, sii kaxayso; take that asunder, baydi; take away, meesha ka qaad, ninka ka kaxai or ka saar; take away his flock, adhigiisa kala tag; take that down, waxaas deji; take him down, iska hoosaysii, iska jooji; I shall take his pride down, amarkiisa waan jebin or basarin; I took him for another, nin kalaan mooday; take from, ka dufo, ka qabo, ka qaad, soo dufo; take of, la tag; take off the skin, haragga or duubka iska jar or goo; take off your hat, koofiyadda iska dhig; take him off from his work, shuqulkiisa ka saar; take out that tooth, iligga soo bixi or soo jiid; take to pieces, jeexjeex; take to, kaxay, soo kaxay; take up arms, hub qaata; that will take up a good deal of time, hawl badan baa igaga bixi doonta; take up the book, kitaabka qaad.
tale: n., (story) sheeko, -adi; he is always telling stories (tales), qalalif buu ka sheekaynayaa; (oral report) dirandiro, -adi; tale bearer, nin xamasho badan; take bearing, xamasho, -adi, dirandiro, -adi.
talk: v.i., v.tr., hadal, haasaw; talk with, la hadal, la haasaw; n., hadal, -ki, haasaaway, -ihi.
tame: a., af yaqaan, la carbiyay; tame beast, marabi, -di; tame beast flying away, buubaal, -shi; v.tr., carbi.
taunt: n., cay, di; v.tr., cay; why do you taunt him? maxaad u caayaysaa or caytamaysaa?
taw: n., (a marble to play with) fatari, -gi.
tear: n., ilmo, -adi; (rent) dilaac, -i, jeex, -i; v.tr., (lacerate) dilaaci, jeex, jeexjeex, kidif.
tent: n., (for travel) balballo, -adi; (in an enclosure) qoys, -ki; (not in an enclosure) qoqob, -ki; (an abode) rug, -ti, bul, -ki, guri, -gi.
that: a. and prn. (see Grammar); c., aan, in, bal aan, ha.
thick: a., adag, buuran, qalafsan, qara weyn.
think: v.., tasho, malay; think of, ka tasho; think well, calooshaada la tasho, malay, mood.
throat: n., hunguri, -gi, cuna, -ihi, booc, -i; the thyroid body or kernel, rubad, -di.
throw: v.tr., xoor, rid, tuur, iska saydh; throw away, tuur, iska tuur; throw down, hoosta u xoor, hoosta u tuur, ka daadi; throw in, at him, ku rid, ku xoor, ku tuur;
thrust in: v.tr., (a nail) ka rid, ka dusi.
thunder: n., onkod, -ki; it thunders, waa onkodaysaa.
tide: n., (time, season) waqti, -gi, xili, -gi; (ebb and flow of the sea) mayad, -di; high tide, buux, -i; low tide, caari, -gi, -di.
tie: v.tr., xidh, xidho; tie the she-camel's teats, mar; tie one side, hasha ka agmar.
till: prp., c., tan iyo goortan, had iyo intan, ilaa, ilaama.
timber: n., (every large tree) damas, -ki, damal, -shi, geed damal ah.
time: n., amin, -ki, -ti, goor, -ti, had, -di, kol, -ki, jir, jeer, mar, -ki, da', -di, mu, -gi, sa, -ki, waa, -gi, yaa, -di, gelin, -ki; a short time, cabbaar, -ki, in gibin ah; after a time, hadhow, hadhowto; a long time, buuran, xili, -gi, waqti, -gi, gu', -gi; time past, awal; the present, goortan joogta; the time to come, kolka dambe; appoint a fixed time, ballan.
tire: v.tr., (make weary) daali; v.i., (fall with weariness) daal, catow, cataysnaw.
tobacco: n., buri, -gi; a kind of tobacco, hamuumi,-gi; a man in want of tobacco, hamuunsan; be in want of tobacco, hamuunsanaw.
tooth: n., ilig, -gi; tooth stick or brush, caday, -gi, rumay, -gi; tooth pick, findhicil gura, -ihi,
top: n., (highest part of a thing) caaro, -adi, aroor, -ki, dul, -shi, guro, adi, jif, -ti; of the head, dhalo, -adi, kug, -ti; peg top, duran, -ki.
torment: n., silic, -i, tacab, -ti; v.tr., cadaab, cadib, kaga-ceysi.
toss: v.tr., (agitate) lul, rux; be tossed, lulan, ruxo.
touch: n., taabasho, -adi; v.tr., taabo; make him touch, taabsii; touch in pressing, tuuji.
tow: n., xig, -gi, xaskul, -shi; tow used for closing the camel's teats, maraq, -i.
trace: track, n., raad, -ki; v.tr., raadi, raadkiisa gur; lose the trace, raad go'.
transfix: v.tr., ka mud bixi, dalooli, musmaar ku dalooli.
translate: v.tr., (transfer) ka kaxay, ka gur; (interpret) u kala af celi.
transmigrate: v.i.; that family transmigrated from his town into another, xaaskaasi magaaladiisa ka taga oo magaalo kale u kaca.
travel: v., dhax, soo dhax, sodcaal, safar; n., sodcaal, -ki, dhoof, -ki.
traveller: n., kabadhay, -ihi, safar leh, -ihi, nin sodcaal ah.
treat: v.tr., ballan; treat with, la ballan.
tree: n., beer, -ti, geed, -ki; (in general) dhir, -ti; tree used to shut the enclosure, dacan, -ti.
tribute: n., baad, -di; pay the tribute, baadda bixi.
trick: n., (mischievous) histi, -gi (see cheat); in game, sir, -ki; play a trick, v.tr., u histi.
trip: n., (in wrestling) qonof, -ki; (a stumble) turunturo, -adi; (a journey) kabadhay, -ihi; take a trip, kusoo wareeg.
trouble: n., daal, -ki, xumaan, -ti, weerweer, -ki; v.tr., daali, qulquladay, weerweeri, rog.
true: a., sax, waa sax, waa run, waa runtiis, waa runteed.
trunk: n., (of a tree) jirid, -ki; (a box) sanduuq, -i; (elephant's) gacan, -ti.
trust: n., yeeshood, -ki, amaano, -adi; v.tr., amaano u dhiib, amaan, amaanayso; v.i., yeesho, ku yeesho.
truth: n., run, -ti, lillaahi, -di, dhab, -ti; confirm the truth, rumay.
try: v.tr., beji, is beji; v.., (endeavour) hawshoo.
tumble: n., (a fall) hambaro, -adi, kuf, -ki; v.i., hambarow, kuf.
turban: n., cimaamad or camaamad, -di; arrange his turban, u cimaamad.
turn: n., wareeg, -gi; v.tr., rog, jeedi, wareeji; upside down, foorori, rog; v.i., jeeso, soo jeeso, wareeg, iska wareeg; turn back, dib u jeeso, dib u noqo; turn by, ku wareeg; turn aside from, il isku qabo.
turtle: n., (sea tortoise) diin badeed, -ki; turtle dove, qoolli, -di.
tusk: n., mici, -di; tusk of the wart hog, kalad, -di.
twelve: num., labiyo toban, -ki; twelfth, labiyo tobnaad, -ki, -di.
twist: n., (see string); v.tr., marooji or maroori, sooh, tidic.
twitch: n., (a quick pull) difad or dufad, -ki; v.tr., dufo, jid.
under: prp., daaf, daafta, hoos, hoosta; be under, hoose; put under, hoosaysii; go under, hoos gal, hoos u gal.
understand: v.tr., garo; do you understand? ma ku dhacday? I understand, i dhacday.
undress: v.tr., dharka iska dhig or iska bixi.
unequal: a., kala mid, isku mid ma'aha.
unfortunate: a., ayaan xun; be unfortuanate, ayaan xumaw.
unintelligible: a., aan la garan, wax aan la karin.
unkind: a., naxariis la', naxariis (ba) ma yaqaan.
up: prp., dul, dusha, gud, gudka, kor; upto, ilaa, ilaama.
upon: prp., dusha, gudka, ku, sare u.
upright: a., hagaagsan, taagan, toosan, qumaati; be upright, hagaagsanaw, hagaag u soco, qumaati u soco, taagnow; make upright, hagaaji, toosi, qumaati u taag.
uproot: v.tr., ruji, fuji, soo fuji; uproot this tree, geedka fuji.
urine: n., kaadi, -di; v.i., kaadi, soo kaadi.
use: n., waxtar, -ki; be of use, wax tar; of no use, ma taro.
vapor: n., uumis, -ki; vapor clinging to the lid, uumi, -gi.
vase: n., (vessel) weel, -ki; vase in which incense is burnt, idan, -ki.
vessel: n., (utensil) weel, -ki, gurgur, -ki; earthen used for cooking, dheri, -gi; bark vessel, agan, -ti; made of a large gourd, baro, -adi, dubbo, -adi, ubo, -adi; vessel made of a camel's skin, tebed, -di; vessel with a handle, hudda, -ihi, tebeda dara,-ihi; used for ablutions before prayer, weyso, -adi.
vex: v.tr., kaga ceysii or ciisii, kaga ciili.
vision: n., (actual sight) muuq, -i; (the thing seen) muuqad, -ki, muuqasho, -adi.
visit: v.tr., ka war doon, inuu nabad qabo soo day.
voyage: n., dhoof, -ki; v.i., dhoof; v.c., dhoofi, dhoofsii.
wait: v.i., v.tr., joog, joogso, dhawr, sug; wait for, u kaadi; wait a moment, cabbaar joog.
wake: waken, v.i., baraarug, kac, sara kac, soo kac, soo jeed.
walk: v., soco, talaab, baydh; take a wash, tamashlay; walk on, mar; walk on all fours, guurguuro; walk on the breech, kurkurso; walk with difficulty, tukub; n., socod, -ki, tamashlay, -ihi; walk on all fours, guurguurasho, -adi; walk on the breech, kurkuris, -ki.
wander: v.., kusoo wareeg; walk about, warwareeg, soo warwareeg; .c., warwareeji, soo warwareeji.
want: n., tabaalo, -adi, sabool, -ki; a man in want, nin baahan or nin wax u baahan; v., (be deficient) tabaalaysnaw; (wish for) doon.
ward: n., (a division of a town) xaafad, -di; v.tr., (guard) ilaali, karaw.
warm: a., (wa) kulul, kulayl; feeling warm, huursan; v.tr., diiri, kululay; warm yourself, kulaal, duksiso; warm at the sun or prepare a warm place, duksi; warm at the fire, ku dhalal.
warning: n., digniin, -ti; send a warning, digniin dir.
warrior: n., gaashan qaad, -ki, hub qaad, geesi, -gi, rakaab, -ki.
wash: v.tr., xal, qasal, maydh, soo maydh, caday; v.r., maydho; wash the hands, faraxal; wash the face, fooldhaq; wash hands, face, v.r., faraxalo, fooldhaqo.
washing: n., maydhasho, -adi;  washing of the hands, faraxal, -ki; washing of the face, fooldhaq, -i.
waste: v.tr., ku cayaar, lumi; waste money, cidlay; do not waste, haku cayaarin; (expend needlessly) xoor, qub.
watch: n., ilaalo, -adi; watch word, baaq, -i; (pocket timepiece) saacad, -di.
water: n., biyo, -ihi (plur. n.); fresh water, biyo macaan; sour water, biyo dhanaan or biyo khadhaadh; salt water, biyo cusba ah; rain water, biyo roob or xareed, -di; well water, weyer, -ki; river water, biyo durdur; water course, tog, -gi; waterfall, biyo garbada kasoo duulay; water bag, sibraar, -ki; v.tr., waraabi; water the flock, aroor, aroori; water before the house, rushay.
way: n., daw, -gi, jid, -ki, marin, -ki, hilin, -ki, dariiq, -i.
wealthy: a., xoolo badan, rawi, -gi, rawi ah, badhaadh ah.
wean: v.tr., ka gudhi; be weaned, gudh, ha laga gudhiyo.
weary: a., daalan, daashan; be weary, daal, daalanaw; v.tr., daali.
weather: n., dabayl, -shi, xeli, -gi; bad weather, dabayl xun; cold weather, dabayl qabow; fair or fine weather, dabayl wanaagsan; hot weather, hanfi, -gi, kaliil, -shi.
well: n., ceel, -ki, goof, -ki; a., ladan, bed qaba, waxsan; ad., aad (with u), hawraarsan, waa waxsan.
wet: a., qoyan; be wet, qoyanaw; wet land, rays, -ki; v.tr., qoy.
when: c., goorta, kolka, marka; interrog. ad., goorma? hadma? kolma? marma?
whence: ad., halka, xagga (with ka); int., xaggee? halkee?
while: n., goor, -ti, kol, -ki; (a short time) cabbaar, -ki; ad., goorta.
whisper: v.., hoos u hadal; whisper to him, hoos ula hadal.
white: a., cad; be white, caddaw; remain white, caddaysnaw.
wife: n., afo, afadi, naag, -ti, islaan, -ti, oori, -di, xilo, -ihi; wife of the father (stepmother), wife of a paternal or maternal uncle, aayo, aayadi.
will: n., qushi, -gi, ogaan, -ti, qawl, -ki, umuur, -ti, oggolaan, -ti; it is my will, baga! qushigay.
win: v.., v.tr., ka adkaw, dul mar.
window: n., daaqad, -di; (of a Somali hut, a kind of hole) food, -ki.
wink: v.., il isku qabo; n., il isku qabasho, qabashadi.
wipe: v.tr., ka bixi; wipe your lips, aftiro.
wise: a., fi'an, garaad leh, herrib leh, miyir leh.
witch: n., naag wax faasha, naag faal taqaan, naagti faalka tiqiin, (the ...); v.tr., (bewitch) faal.
witness: n., marqaati, -gi; v.tr., (give testimony) fur, marqaati ku fur.
wonder: n., cajeb, -ti, yaab, -ki, la yaab, -ki, umuur, -ti; v. (wonder at) la cajeb, yaab, la yaab, la yaabsanaw; cause to wonder, cajebi, yaabi.
wonderful: a., yaaban, yaab qaba, yaab leh, yaabsan, la yaabsan.
wood: n., qori, gi; fire, xaabo, -adi, xatab, -ki; hard wood, qori qaro leh.
wooden: a., qori ah, qori laga sameeyay.
word: h., eray, -gi, qawl, -ki; bad word, ceeb, -ti.
work: n., shuqul, -ki, shaqi, -gi. hawl, -shi; hard work, dhibtan, -ki; v.tr., hawl qabo, hawshoo, xooji, shaqay; work hard, dhibtan; v.c., shaqaysi; for yourself, shaqayso.
workman: n., shaqi, -gi, nin shaqi ah; hard-working man, dhibtan, -ki.
worse: a., ka xun; become wprse, ka sii dar.
worst: a., ka wada xun, ugu xun.
wound: n., nabar, -ki, dakhar, -ki, qoon, -ti, cawar, -ki; a new, dakhar cusub, dakharki cusbaa (the ...); v.tr., dakhar, qoon, nabar yeel.
wounded: a., dakhar leh, qoon leh, nabar leh; mortally wounded, dhinsan.
wrestle: n., legdan, -ki, tab, -ti; v.i., legdan; wrestle with, la legdan.
wretch: n., lumiyay, -ihi, Allaah qabay, -gi, nin Allaah qabay ah.
writing: n., qorriin, ki; hand writing, far, -ti.
yawn: v.i., afka kala qaad, afka kala hay.
yawning: n., af kala qaad, -ki, af kala hays, -ki.
year: n., sanad, -di, gu, -gi, kal, -ki; last year, kal horay, sanad horay; next year, kal dambe, gu dambe; past year, sanad dhoweyd; the coming year, sanadda soo socota; the being in years, gaan, -ki, qaan, -ki.
yesterday: ad., shalay, shalayto; the day before yesterday, dorraad; yesterday night, xalay.
yield: v.tr., (produce) yeel; (grant) bixi, sii; v.i., oggolaw.
yon: yonder, ad., halkaa, halkoo, meesha, meeshoo, shishay, u shishay (the farthest).
you: ye, pers.prn., (see Grammar), ow, yow (used as affixes).
young man: n., baxsi, -gi, barbaar, -ki, dhalinyaro, -adi, mudakar, -ki; younger son, curadxigay, -ihi; the youngest, kan ugu yar, gar u dambays.
youth: n., da' yar, -di, da' yarayd, dhalinyaro, -adi, barbaar, -ki.
zariba: n., xero, xeradi; zariba of thorns, xero qodax leh; make a zariba, xero ood.
zereba: n., xero, xeradi; zereba of thorns, xero qodax leh; make a zereba, xero ood.
zigzag: n., baydhbaydh, -ki; walk in zigzag (as a snake), v.i., baydh-baydh.
abaaro: v.i., aim at, go straight to.
abaardhawr: f.n., a fertile place, neither wet nor dry. -ti.
Aabbaha: n., the Father (first Person of the blessed Trinity).
abbaarihi: ad., about; abbaarihi labiyo tobanki yuu noo yimi, he came to us at about 12 o'clock.
cadaabay: a.; nin la cadaabay, a damned man, reprobate (see cadaab, hell).
adkaan: f.n., firmness, hardness, victory, Confirmation (sacrament of). -ti.
axal: f.n., viscous matter mixed with blood in dysentery. -shi.
calal: m.n., crop (the first stomach of a fowl). -ki.
Allaah qabay: m.n., reprobate, abject man, wretch. -gi; nin Allaah qabay ah.
alwaax: f.n. (plur. of loox), planks. -di; alwaaxda sarabkeeda, flooring.
calyo murux: m.n., slaver or spittle drivelling from the mouth. -i (see calyo, saliva).
calyo murux iska buuxi, v.i., slabber, slaver, drivel, besmear with saliva.
calyo murux ku daadi, v.tr., slabber, smear or wet with saliva.
(nin) calyo murux weyn leh, m.n., slabberer; ninki calyo murux weynaa, the slabberer.
arah doonato: f.n., a seeker of fruits in the jungle.
cararaf: m.n., affliction, suffering. -ki. This word is used when the pain of the soul or of the body is so intense that it would be preferable to die.
caway: v.i., do not sleep, remain awake and chat. -ya, wan cawayn.
caways: m.n., time from 8 p.m. to midnight. -ki.
cawaldar: m.n., sergeant or corporal (of the police). -ki.
aadyar: (see aayar), ad., slowly; aadyar iyo aadyar, little by little.
badow: m. and f.n., rustic (coming directly from the jungle). -gi, -di; nin, naag badow ah, a rustic man, woman.
baydh: (root), walk, march, go; ka baydh, give place...
bayr: m.n., clippspringer (with long ears but smooth hair of the same colour as those of a gazelle). -ki.
bar: m.n., top, head, poll of a tree. -ki; dhirta barkooda.
bar ma leh, a., poor (without any money); ninkaasi bar ma laha, this man is quite poor.
bar or barka sare, m.n., fore-part.
bara duub leh, m.n., small mouse (a kind of kangaroo rat).
bariidi: v.tr., greet, salute (see bari, be safe).
bedelan: v.p., be changed; bedelma, waan bedelmi.
boqon: f.n., the great sinew over the heel. -ti; -horay, in-step.
burco: m.n., a mound of sand; burcaha.
buuro isku yaal: m.n., a range of mountains; buurihi is ku yiil (plur.), the...
dhabay: v.tr., affirm, assure; kaga dhabay, make certain.
dalaaq: dalaaq, v.tr., divorce; sadexda dalaaqood baad igaga furaysan tahay (a kind of swearing by which they pledge themselves to divorce).
dhamooq: (see ku dhamooq), v.tr., put on a plaster, poultice.
dan: (see Part I.); waa dantiisi, or waa isagi iyo dantii, it is his concern; ayaa dan leh? who has anything to say? anaa dan leh, I have something to say; nin oo dhan dan u ma lihi, I care for nobody.
dhardhaar: m.n., the three stones on which they put their boiler. -ki.
waa dhebay: locution, he has committed fornication, adultery; waa i dhebay, he has committed adultery with me. These expressions are used in the Ogaden, and by the Dulbanteh and Darod.
dheg: (see Part I.); ku dhega, ku dhegta, a., adhesive.
dhegta dahasheeda: locution, the tip of the ear.
sii dheeray: v.tr., deepen (sink far below the surface).
dheereeyay: a.v., rapid, swift, quick in running.
dhergi: v.tr., satiate, make him abound, give him as much as he wishes.
didi: didi, m.n., the getting angry, wild in playing. -gi.
didi, v.., get angry; didiya, waan didiyi.
didib: f.n., declivity, slope (so abrupt that it is impossible to stand on). -ti.
didibsan: a., having the legs extended, stretched out.
difad or dufad: m.n., a twitch, a quick pull. -ki.
dilid,: f.n., murder.-di; or dil, m.n., homicide. -ki.
dhiman: v., decrease, grow less; dhinma, waan dhinmi.
dhinac: m.n., fillet (the loins of oxen, horses, &c. -ki, -yo (see sarar).
dhiiran: (nin), a., a hero, a man never afraid; ninki dhiiranaa, the hero.
diriq: f.n., puddle or muddy standing water. -di.
dhool: f.n., the second tooth (upper and under one). -shi, -o.
du: v.tr., remove, keep off; -a, waan duwi; ka duw, keep from, dissuade.
dhuuban: a., long, acute (see dheer); san dhuuban, a long nose; sanki dhuubnaa, the...
duf: m.n., storm, tempest. -ki; duf ba dhacaya, there is a storm.
is ku dhufo: v.tr., drink liquors, wine, make yourself drunk (lit. beat yourself).
dhugtan: v.p., be aiming at; dhugtama, waan dhugtami.
dumaal: v.tr., marry your sister-in-law, marry a second time.
dhumuc: f.n., size. -di ; dhumux weyn, big; dhumuc yar, thin, small.
edeg: m.n., a small fold for lambs and kids (within the enclosure). -gi.
ku eeri: (see Dictionary), v.tr., drive into; musmaar ku eeri, drive in a nail; ka eeri, drive out.
fadhi: (see Dictionary); fadhi farda ah, a herd of horses; fadhi lo' ah, a herd of neat cattle.
fag: v.tr., take off the warp or the woof of cloth to make thread.
faqiirow: v.tr., beg (alms); sii faqiirow, beg always; ninkaasi waa faqiiran yahay, this man is always doing the same work.
faali: v.tr., foretell, predict; ninki baa ii faaliyay inaan goor dhow dhimanaya, the man foretold me that I was to die soon.
fanax garaacis: m.n., beating repeatedly on the knuckles. -ki.
farriin: f.n., the word said. -ti; farriin iigu gey, go and tell him what I said to you.
fayo: fayo wanaagsan, nice features; fayihi wanaagsana, the... (see qorisho).
fiid: m.n., first part of the night, from sunset to 8 o'clock.
fuuqfuuqso: v.i., gully, make noise with the lips in drinking (see kalo).
fuji: or soo fuji, v.tr., separate, take out (see ruji); kala fuji, separate (two things joined).
gabil: f.n., a skin of a cow or a camel used to shade children when on camels. -shi.
gamod: m.n., water coming from the gadhoodh, curdled milk. -ki.
gantaal: f.n., arrow. -shi. (When the stick and the arrow are joined they form the arrow, which is called fallaadh, gantaal, degaalay.)
guro: f.n., a place prepared on camels for small children.
hab: v.tr., clean a plate by eating what remains on it.
xaadir: a., present; waa ku xaadir, he is present.
xag Eebbeheen: or Eebbahay, locution, towards God, for the sake of God.
haga: or hagi, ad., all right; waa hagi, it is all right, good, well, it is so.
xajolad: f.n., talisman (made of silver, and ordinarily tied to the upper part of the arm). -di.
hangaraarac: m.n., a kind of centipede. -i (see Dictionary).
xaaraansan: wax waliba iga xaaraansan, an oath often used by the Somalis. (By this oath they bind themselves to a divorce.)
xaskul: f.n., tow (made from the bark of trees). -shi.
xishood: m.n. (see Dictionary); means also disgrace, discredit, dis-honour.
xilo: m.n. sing. and pl., wife, wives. -hi; xilahaygu waa sadexdi dalaqadood inayan aqalka ku jirahayn, I divorce you by three divorces (oath having the same meaning as that of the word dalaaq, which see).
qabil: m.n., skins sewn together and used as cradles for babies. -ki.
qaybay: a., adulterated; waa rubiyad qaybay ah or qayba ah, this rupee is adulterated, is false.
qalab leh: a., shagged, shaggy, hairy, rough, having long hair.
qamis: m.n., poisonous arrow; kolka fallaadhu doxbantahay waxa la yidhaahdaa qamis, when the arrow is poisoned they call it qamis.
qumbaho: v.., fall sick again; qumbahda, waan qumbahan.
katolik: m.n., Catholic. -gi; katholiga ah, a Catholic.
kidif: v.tr., tear or cut into small pieces; kidfa, waan kidfi.
kudmo: f.n., sodomy (used also for fornication; see wasmo).
kurtun: m.n., stump of a tree become dry.
Inanka: -i, -u, n., the Son (Second Person of the Blessed Trinity).
ha i gedmin: ha i jedmin, do not distract me.
jirso: v.i., be old; wiilkaasu toddoba jirsay or jirsaday, this boy is seven years old; soo jirso, take shelter; aqalka soo jirso.
junub: f.n., pollution during sleep. -ti; is ku junub, have a pollution during sleep.
lillaah: m.n. (see Dictionary), God. -hi. This word means especially 'the truth'.
limad: m.n., slough, a deep miry place. -ki.
lool: looli v.tr., amuse, cause to play.
lool: m.n., boughs used in making the Somali hut (see dig lola). -ki.
madal: m.n., a measure of uncooked rice. -ki.
masxad: f.n., ointment, unction. -di; masxadda aakhir ah or masxadda dadka buka, Extreme Unction.
mindhaa?: part. int. neg., is it not?
mudka: m.n., the place after the shaf in the camel's chest. -ki.
is nac: v.r. (see nac, Dictionary), abnegate, renounce yourself.
nab: v.tr., splash; timaha nab, splash your hair flat with lime or mud; ku nab, glue.
Rabbi: m.n., God. -gi. This word means especially 'the Lord.'
raacid: fn., the accompanying, going along with.
duca ku raag: m.n., ascetic, praying a long time. -gi (see raag, delay...).
rash: m.n., shot (any kind of shot, as dust-shot ...). -ki.
rido: v.r., pitch, throw, upset yourself; rida, waan ridan.
Ruuxa Quduuska ah: prop. n., the Holy Ghost (Third Person of the Blessed Trinity).
Sadexmidnimada: i, prop. n., the Trinity (of God).
seeg: v.tr., miss, omit; salaaddii baan seegay, I omitted, missed the prayer.
sir (sirid): sir, f.n., a cheating in a game, trick. -ti.
is tun: (see tun, forge), v.i., clash; ku tun, strike upon.
ulakac: fn., will, -di; ninka ulakacdiisu waa mid ba'an, the will of that man is a bad one.
usar: m.n., scum. -ki; usarka ka safay, skim.
waajib: This word means must, 'obliged,' 'necessary'; it is used as follows: 1st pers., igu waajib, I must, I am obliged, it is necessary for me; 2nd pers., kugu waajib; 3rd pers. sing. and plur., ku waajib; 1st pers. plur., inagu waajib; 2nd pers. plur., idin ku waajib.
waal: (root), v.tr., v.i., madden, to become mad.
walax: f.n., thing. -di. This word is especially used for invisible things.
weydhaafi: v.tr., throw, cast headlong; soo -, is -, throw yourself.
weer: m.n., a linen surrounding the head (emblem of mourning). -ki.
weer, v.tr., surround the head... on account of mourning.
weero: v.r., surround your head...; weerta, waan weeran.

abwaanno.name: Abwaan Urursan (Qaamuus Af-Soomaali - Af-Ruush) - D. I. Estebanyenko, Maxamed Xaaji Cismaan [1969]

aad: очень, весьма; вполне; ~ iyo ~ очень, сильно; понастоящему.
aan: без-, не-; ~ deegin не-достаточный; - dhadhan la һауп безвкусный, невкус-ный; ~ garaad la hayn бездарный (о человеке); habaysnayn перегулярный: ~ xad la hayn безгранич-ный, беспредельный; - хаlliban ahayn мутный, непрозрачный; ~ jігіп отсут-ствующий; ~ la aqoon незнакомый; безвестный; ~ la arkin невидимый; ~ macne lа һаул незначитель-ный, маловажный; - run аһауп фальшивый, неверный; ~ wax tarin бесполезный,

aa': v. tr. 1 (ay, day) 1. Minacciare qn.; colpire qn. o qs.; aggredire qn. 2. Is a.: combattere; scontrarsi; azzuffarsi.
aa: aa2 pr. cl. so. 1. vr. di aad'. 2. vr. di aydin.
aa³ es. - Ahi!; ah! (per esprimere dolore).
aabayeel: aabayeel v. it. 1 (-eelay, -eeshay) - U a.: dare importanza a qs., avere interesse per qs.
aabayeelid: nv. f. di aabayeel?. vr. aabayeel'.
aabbe: n. m. (-bayaal, m. of.)- 1. Padre. 2. Il pl. anche: antenati.
aabbur: n. m. (-rro, f) - Coperchio concavo che viene inserito nell'apertura del recipiente e non appoggiato.
aabbur2 v. tr. I (-ray, -rtay) Tappare qs.; chiudere o coprire con un coperchio qs.
aabburan: v. it. 1 (-rmay, -rantay; -rmi) - Venire tappato; venire chiuso o coperto con un coperchio.
aabburan2 v. it. 4 (-rnaa, -rnayd) - Essere tappato; essere chiuso o coperto con un coperchio.
aabburnaan: nv. f. di aabburan?, vr. aabburnaansho.
aabburnaansho: n. m. of. vr. di aabburnaan.
aabee: v. tr. 2 (-eeyay, -eysay) - 1. Tenere conto di qn. o qs., attribuire importanza a qn. o qs. 2. Ungere o spalmare di resina qs. per impermeabilizzarlo (og. un recipiente).
aabiweyrax: n. m. (-xyo, f.)- Reazione violenta, aggressione ingiustificata.
aabyoo: v. it. 3 (-ooday, -ootay) - Ku a.: offendere qn., fare una prepotenza a qn., essere arrogante con qn.
aad: n. m. - 1. (-dyo, f.) Isku aa. cayaar: incontro di gioco, partita. 2. vr. di aadid.
aad2 n. f. av. 1. Molto, bene. 2. A. yar: vr. di aayar.

aad3 v. 1 (-day, -dday) - 1. tr. Recarsi in un lg., partire per un lg. 2. it. Ku a.: reggere il confronto con qn. o qs., essere pari a qn. o qs.; essere puntato o rivolto verso qn. o qs.; allinearsi; adattarsi.
aad pr. cl. so. 1. vr. aa². Tu. 2. vr. di aydin.
aadaab: n. m. Educazione, il comportarsi bene o educatamente.
aadaamid: nv. f. di aadaan2, vr. aadaan', aaddamid, aaddan', eedaamid, eedaan'.
aadaan: aadaan2 v. it. 1 (-aamay, -aantay), vr. aaddan2, eedaan2-1. Invitare o chiamare alla preghiera (so. muezzin). 2. Lamentarsi per il dolore (so. capra).
aadami: n. m. co., vr. aadane, aadmi - 1. Umanità, esseri umani. 2. A. ahaan: condizione umana, natura umana.
aadaminnimo: n. f., vr. aadminnimo - Umanità, l'essere umani.
